Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: 
 Samsara's Connected Operations platform helps organizations that depend on physical operations — fleets, construction, utilities, public works, and first responders — run safer, more efficiently, and more sustainably.  
 We're looking for a Group Manager, Product Marketing Manager, Public Sector to own the narrative, positioning, and enablement that will define how Samsara wins in government. You'll be the team's expert on how public sector buyers evaluate technology — from the contract vehicles they procure through, to the compliance bar they hold vendors to, to the mission outcomes they're ultimately accountable for.  
 This is a strategic, cross-functional role for someone who already understands government and frameworks like FedRAMP and StateRAMP/GovRAMP. The ideal candidate is someone who wants to build a public sector product marketing motion, not just execute inside one that already exists. 
 This is a remote position open to candidates based in the U.S. We prefer candidates based in or near Washington, D.C., or those able to work Eastern time zone hours. 
 You should apply if: 
 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your work will have real-world stakes — helping public agencies keep roads plowed, fleets safe, and essential services running for the communities they serve. 
 You're fluent in how the government buys technology: You understand procurement cycles, contract vehicles, and compliance frameworks well enough to turn them into a go-to-market advantage rather than a blocker. 
 You're energized by building, not just executing: Samsara's federal go-to-market motion is still being defined — you'll have real ownership over the frameworks, positioning, and playbooks that shape it. 
 You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development. 
 You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You'll be surrounded by a high-caliber team that pushes you to do your best work. 
 
 In this role, you will: 
 
 Lead as a player-coach: Manage a direct report while helping build the public sector PMM team's foundation — sharing in the strategic work, coaching for growth, and creating the frameworks that enable the function to scale. 
 Own public sector positioning and messaging: Develop and evolve Samsara's core narrative for government buyers across federal, state, local, and education segments — grounded in mission outcomes rather than generic product benefits 
 Build Samsara's federal go-to-market foundation: Partner cross-functionally to define how Samsara approaches the federal market, including messaging and enablement that reflect our compliance roadmap as it evolves 
 Translate compliance into a sales advantage: Understand the FedRAMP authorization process and impact levels — deeply enough to explain it clearly to sales teams and prospects, and to inform internal conversations about authorization strategy and timing 
 Drive product and platform launches for public sector: Localize Samsara's launches for a government audience, ensuring messaging reflects agency use cases, procurement realities, and compliance considerations 
 Enable sales and channel teams: Build battlecards, objection-handling guides, RFP/RFI response content, and compliance-focused sales collateral that helps account teams and channel partners win competitive government deals 
 Support competitive intelligence for public sector: Track how competitors position themselves to government buyers, and translate that intelligence into differentiated Samsara messaging and sales guidance 
 Represent Samsara at public sector events and forums: Support flagship industry events and partner conferences with content, speaking support, and thought leadership 
 
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
 
 7+ years of product marketing (or closely related go-to-market) experience, with a meaningful portion of that focused on public sector / government technology marketing (B2G) 
 Working knowledge of the FedRAMP authorization process, and general familiarity with adjacent compliance frameworks (e.g., StateRAMP/GovRAMP, NIST 800-53), with the ability to translate them into clear guidance for internal teams 
 Proven ability to independently own strategic programs from conception to completion, and to influence cross-functional partners without direct authority 
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — able to translate complex topics into clear, compelling narratives for technical and non-technical audiences alike 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience 
 
 An ideal candidate also has: 
 
 Experience managing a direct report or small team is strongly preferred 
 Direct experience supporting a company through a FedRAMP or StateRAMP/GovRAMP authorization process 
 Experience marketing connected devices, hardware-enabled, or physical-operations software platforms 
 Prior experience in government or a public sector-focused vendor or agency role 
 Established relationships within the Carahsoft ecosystem or with other public sector aggregators/resellers 
 Experience building a public sector or new-market go-to-market motion from scratch — including positioning frameworks and playbooks designed to scale beyond your own work

Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. Annual Base Salary $119,297.50 — $210,000 USD Total Rewards 
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. 
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. jobs.excerpt:
The GTM Operations Associate - Channels & Alliances will join a global team driving Datadog's next phase of growth. We are interdisciplinary thinkers with diverse backgrounds across consulting, finance, strategy, operations, and technology. Our team partners directly with GTM leaders to improve operational efficiency, support data-driven decision-making, and scale the processes and systems that enable continued growth. 
 In this role, you will serve as an operational partner to Datadog's Channels & Alliances organization. You will execute critical business operations, support reporting and business systems, and help scale operational processes across the organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our C&A teams have the tools, data, and operational support they need to be successful. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, systems thinking, and a passion for improving how teams operate. 
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 
 What you'll do: 
 
 Own recurring operational processes that support the global Channels & Alliances organization, ensuring execution is timely, accurate, and scalable. 
 Build, maintain, and enhance Salesforce reports and dashboards to provide visibility into pipeline, partner performance, and other key business metrics. 
 Partner with C&A, Revenue Operations, Systems, Sales, and other cross-functional teams to improve operational workflows, resolve business issues, and ensure data integrity across systems. 
 Coordinate with and evaluate external vendors to support operational processes, systems enhancements, and business initiatives. 
 Create and maintain process documentation, playbooks, and standard operating procedures to improve consistency and scalability across the organization. 
 Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and leverage AI-enabled tools to improve operational efficiency and reduce administrative work. 
 Serve as a trusted operational resource for the Channels & Alliances organization, balancing multiple priorities while delivering high-quality support to stakeholders across the business. 
 
 Who you are: 
 
 Bachelor's degree. 
 2–4 years of experience in Business Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Strategy & Operations, or a similar operational role, preferably within a SaaS or high-growth technology company. 
 Experience building and maintaining Salesforce reports and dashboards, with a strong understanding of CRM data and reporting best practices. 
 Strong analytical skills with experience using Excel or Google Sheets to organize data, identify trends, and support business decisions. 
 Experience working with business systems and operational tooling, with the ability to quickly learn new platforms and support system enhancements. 
 Excellent organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. 
 Demonstrated ownership and accountability, with a track record of improving operational processes and driving projects to completion. 
 
 Bonus points: 
 
 Experience supporting Channels & Alliances/Partnerships organizations. 
 Experience working with third-party vendors or technology providers to implement or improve business processes. 
 Familiarity with workflow automation, AI/LLM tools, or no-code automation platforms. 
 
 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 
 Benefits & Growth: 
 
 Generous and competitive benefits package 
 New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan 
 Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
 Employee-focused best in class onboarding 
 Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program 
 Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.  Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence.  Develop repeatable processes, playbooks, and operating rhythms that help partner marketing scale with the business across segments and geographies.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present to audiences large and small and create clear, compelling content—from concise partner communications to detailed launch plans and thought leadership. 
 Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, customer- and partner-centric messaging for different audiences. 
 Experience with AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.)

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us 
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. 
 Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. 
 As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 
 About the Role 
 We're looking for a Marketing Operations Manager on our Marketing Operations team to own lead management and revenue handoff — the routing logic and BDR tooling workflows leads and contacts move through, and the rules that determine how and when marketing hands them to sales. 
 This role owns the scoring and routing logic that runs on our core marketing and sales platforms, plus a set of adjacent lifecycle processes — MQL definitions, SLA design, lead source governance, ABM list management, and partner-sourced lead triage. You'll partner with our Sr. Marketing Operations & Technology Manager, who owns core platform administration, and with Sales/BDR leadership on the day-to-day handoff relationship. 
 This is a full-time, fully remote position based in Costa Rica, with working hours aligned to the Central Time zone to support close, real-time collaboration with our Oakland, CA-based team and US sales organization. 
 Technologies You’ll Use 
 
 Marketo, LeanData, Salesforce, Outreach, Nooks, Clay, etc. 
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Scoring & Routing 
 
 Build, maintain, and calibrate the lead scoring model in Marketo, using BDR feedback and closed-won/lost data to keep it predictive rather than stale 
 Own lead routing logic and governance in LeanData — match rules, ownership logic, and routing paths — in partnership with the Sr. Marketing Operations & Technology Manager on platform administration 
 Own MQL definitions and the marketing-to-sales handoff process, including SLA design and ongoing SLA monitoring 
 
 Lifecycle & Handoff Processes 
 
 Own lead/contact lifecycle status management and lead source governance 
 Own inbound and partner-sourced lead triage/routing processes 
 Manage ABM account list and signal strategy in partnership with enterprise sales stakeholders 
 Optimize BDR tooling workflows across Outreach, Nooks, and Clay — sequence/cadence logic, data flow between tools, and adoption — within the platform and vendor decisions set by Systems and leadership 
 Set and enforce SFDC data entry standards for sales-owned fields relevant to lead/contact records, in partnership with Sales leadership 
 Run a regular Sales & MOps alignment cadence with sales/BDR leadership to review routing and handoff health 
 
 Skills We’re Looking For 
 
 4–6 years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, or lifecycle roles in B2B SaaS or high-growth environments 
 Direct, hands-on experience building and calibrating lead scoring models in Marketo 
 Experience owning lead routing logic in LeanData or a comparable platform 
 Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to validate routing and scoring outcomes against CRM data 
 Experience partnering with sales or BDR leadership on lead handoff logic, SLAs, routing rules, and CRM data standards 
 Comfortable working independently across US business hours as part of a distributed team 
 Ability to use conversational AI systems (like Claude, ChatGPT, or internal tools) to support researching, documenting, and troubleshooting scoring and routing logic, and to synthesize funnel/handoff diagnostics 
 
 (Optional )Bonus Skills​ 
 
 Experience working within BDR-facing tools (Outreach, Nooks, Clay, or comparable) to improve workflow efficiency 
 Experience with Bizible/Marketo Measure, Demandbase, or other ABM platforms 
 Prior experience mentoring or supporting more junior marketing operations team members 
 Experience setting or enforcing CRM data governance standards for a sales organization 

 #LI-REMOTE 
 #LI-JC1   
 Perks and Benefits 
 
 100% employer-paid medical insurance * 
 Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off 
 RSU stock grants* 
 Professional development and training opportunities 
 Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities 
 Monthly cell phone stipend 
 Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. 
 
 * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information 
 Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. 
 
 We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our  core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in  Forbes .      
 Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

Our Mission: 
 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. 
 Our People: 
 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.  As our Partner Marketing Manager you will be responsible for turning strategic partnerships into a measurable pipeline motion- building the co-marketing programs, and partner activation strategies that help communicate the power of 6Sense alongside our key partners. This is a builder's role for someone who wants to own a meaningful piece of how 6sense grows, and who understands that great partner marketing sits at the intersection of relationship depth and disciplined execution.   
 Responsibilities :   
 
 Joint Go-to-Market Programs Build and run co-marketing programs with strategic partners ,  from end to end: partner alignment, asset development, campaign execution, field activation, and measurement. Own the pipeline contribution from partner marketing activity and be accountable for reporting it clearly.   
 Joint Events and Activations Own the partner presence at key industry events (including our own,  BreakThrough ), co-hosted webinars, and joint field programs. Coordinate  logistics , messaging, and follow-up across both sides of the partnership to make sure activations generate  pipeline .   
 Partner Relationships Serve as the primary marketing counterpart to partner marketing and alliances teams at key accounts. Build the kind of working relationships where partner counterparts are actively seeking  us out. Create  opportunities  for 6sense to  co-present at joint  events, and  develop the trust that makes joint programs move faster.   
 Partner Marketing Metrics Define what success looks like for partner marketing at 6sense,  working with marketing operations to  build the reporting infrastructure to measure it, and communicate results to marketing leadership and BD stakeholders on a regul ar  cade nce .   
 Performance Measurement   
 Partner-Sourced Pipeline Volume and velocity of pipeline generated through co-marketing programs and partner activations, tracked with clear attribution.   
 Partner Marketing Engagement Depth of engagement from partner counterparts: co-investment in programs, co-branded content produced, joint events executed, and partner-sourced leads generated.   
 Enablement Adoption Usage and effectiveness of partner-facing enablement materials, measured by partner sales team feedback and co-sell conversation rates.   
 Program Execution Quality On-time, on-brief delivery of co-marketing programs - with the partner relationship strengthened as a result.   
 
 Competencies and Behaviors:   
 
 Influence Without Authority  Operates effectively in an environment where the people you most depend on (partner counterparts, internal sales, product marketing) don't report into the same leadership. Builds alignment through credibility and relationships.   
 Revenue-First Thinking  Connects every program to pipeline and revenue. Doesn't measure success by content produced or events run. Asks "what did this produce?" and builds programs that are designed to answer that question.   
 Partner-Facing Presence  Comfortable representing 6sense externally. Shows up in partner conversations with enough confidence and preparation to be a genuine asset in the room.   
 Execution Discipline  Manages the complexity of co-marketing at pace. Gets joint programs across the finish line even when approval chains are complex.   
 Cross-Functional Orchestration Works fluidly across product marketing, demand generation, content, field marketing, and BD to bring partner programs to life. 
 
 Educational and Experience Requirements: 
 
 5 or more years in B2B marketing, with at least 2 years in a field marketing role, partner marketing, alliance marketing, or ecosystem marketing role where you owned outcomes and field programs.   
 Experience working directly with external partner stakeholders. You have presented to partner leadership, negotiated co-marketing agreements, and maintained productive relationships through disagreements.   
 A clear point of view on how to measure partner marketing impact, including how to handle the attribution ambiguity that comes with the territory.   
 Familiarity with the B2B SaaS technology ecosystem: how ISV partnerships, technology integrations, and co-sell motions work in practice.

jobs.excerpt:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 
 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. 
 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity  
 Grafana's Demand Generation team is responsible for creating and accelerating pipeline across the full customer journey — from first touch through expansion. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists. 
 We're hiring a Demand Generation Program Manager — a generalist who can own programs across channels and audiences, with a first focus on our existing-customer motion: driving expansion and cross-sell demand within accounts that already use Grafana. This is one of the biggest growth opportunities in the business and one of the least-covered by traditional demand gen. 
 This is not a "run the playbook" role. We expect this person to build with AI as a default — designing agentic workflows that scale programs beyond what headcount alone could, and pushing the team forward on how demand gen should operate in 2026 and beyond. 
 You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works — where AI agents run real production programs, and where the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. If you want to define what a demand gen career looks like in the agentic era, this is the seat to do it from. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 
 Own customer lifecycle demand gen. Build and run programs that create demand inside our existing customer base — expansion, cross-sell, and adoption plays across email, in-app, web, and field channels, in partnership with sales and customer teams. 
 Work across channels, not in one. Support and strengthen programs across paid, email, events, web, and outbound as team priorities shift. You'll be the person who can step into any channel and make the program better. 
 Build agentic workflows. Use AI tools (Claude Code, agents, internal AI infrastructure) to automate program execution — audience building, content generation, signal detection, campaign QA — and treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not a side project. 
 Connect programs to the sales motion. Translate marketing signals into actions sellers actually take: account coverage, buying signals, campaign follow-up. Partner directly with sales leadership on what's working. 
 Measure what matters. Instrument your programs, report on pipeline impact honestly, and kill what isn't working. 
 
 What Makes You a Great Fit 
 
 5+ years in demand generation, growth marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source / developer-focused a plus). 
 Proven range: you've run programs in at least two or three channels (email/lifecycle, paid, events, web, outbound) and can point to pipeline results in each. 
 Experience marketing to existing customers — expansion, cross-sell, or customer lifecycle programs — not just net-new acquisition. 
 Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword. 
 Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust. 
 Strong program management fundamentals — you ship on time, communicate proactively, and work well with sales, product marketing, and ops without needing a coordinator. 
 
 Bonus Points For 
 
 Experience with PLG or product-led motions alongside sales-led ones. 
 Familiarity with the observability / monitoring / open source ecosystem. 
 You've worked in Marketo, Salesforce, and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar). 
 You've written or shipped something public about AI in marketing operations. 
 
 In the US, the base compensation range for this role is $ 100,000   - $ 120,000 .  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. 
 *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. 
 Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 
 
 100% Remote, Global Culture -  As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. 
 Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. 
 Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. 
 Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. 
 Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. 
 Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. 
 Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. 
 Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. 
 Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. 
 In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.  
 Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. 
 
 Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. 
 Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. 
 #LI-Remote

jobs.title: Marketing Financial Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are  
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to  hundreds of thousands of businesses  and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. 
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . 
 Hiring and how we work 
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!  
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.  . See yourself at Twilio 
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Marketing Financial Manager. 
 About the job 
 This position is needed to drive end-to-end operational budget management, financial forecasting, and strategic decision support across Twilio’s global Marketing organization. 
 You will serve as a trusted finance partner supporting a global Marketing footprint and multi-million dollar program budget. You will independently own forecasting mechanics, lead in-quarter budget pacing and redeployment, modernize financial workflows using automation, and evaluate marketing investment returns to ensure spend drives profitable growth. 
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you’ll: 
 
 Manage Marketing’s total OPEX budget, taking end-to-end ownership of headcount/payroll modeling and detailed PO-level program spend tracking across 10 distinct Marketing functions. 
 Drive strategic financial planning, monthly and quarterly forecasting, and long-term financial modeling across the entire Marketing organization. 
 Lead in-quarter budget pacing with Marketing leadership to maintain spend discipline and reallocate uncommitted funds to high-priority initiatives. 
 Partner closely with Accounting on month-end accruals and close processes, while coordinating with Procurement/Sourcing on PR and PO workflows. 
 Execute ad hoc financial analyses, ROI evaluations, and decision support for strategic marketing programs, vendor renewals, and org changes. 
 Modernize forecasting workflows using FP&A systems, data analytics, and automation tools to streamline processes and shorten cycle times. 

 Qualifications  
 Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! 
 *Required: 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or equivalent practical experience. 
 8+ years of progressive corporate finance, FP&A, or strategic finance experience, ideally in a high-growth technology or enterprise SaaS environment. 
 Proven experience managing high-volume OPEX program budgets ($50M+), complex PO tracking, vendor accruals (in accordance with US GAAP), and headcount forecasting across multi-functional teams. 
 Demonstrated ability to work independently with senior leaders (Director and VP level) to drive budget accountability and explain financial concepts concisely. 
 Advanced financial modeling skills (Excel/Google Sheets) and hands-on experience with enterprise FP&A platforms (e.g., Anaplan, Pigment, Adaptive), ERP systems (e.g., Oracle, NetSuite), and HCM/recruiting systems (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse). 
 
 Desired: 
 
 Direct FP&A experience supporting Marketing or GTM functions, with a proven track record of partnering with Sales and Marketing teams. 
 Experience modernizing financial workflows, automating manual tasks, and leveraging data tools (e.g., SQL, PowerBI, Tableau, or AI-assisted financial tools). 
 Demonstrated ability to translate marketing and sales performance metrics into top-line business growth and return on investment (ROI). 

 Location 
 This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA. 
 Travel  
 We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. 
   
 What We Offer 
 Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. 
   
 Compensation 
 *Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only. 
 The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: 
 
 Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960  - $146,200. 
 Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760 - $154,700. 
 Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 - $206,280. 
 This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. 
 
 The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. 
   
 Application deadline information (required for ALL US jobs) 
 Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until October 30th, 2026  but may change based on business needs.  
   Twilio thinks big. Do you? 
 We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. 
 So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The Executive Content & Experiences team builds trusted relationships with leaders shaping the global economy. We design high-impact programs—including executive briefings, advisory boards, flagship convenings at Davos, and executive programming at Stripe Sessions—to bring Stripe's strategy to life. Beyond delivering premier high-touch moments, we turn leadership insights into actionable intelligence that directly informs Stripe’s narratives, product, and go-to-market direction. 
 What you’ll do 
 We are looking for a rock star product marketer to translate Stripe’s most complex technology and strategy into compelling, executive-ready narratives and scalable sales motions. In this role, you will lead the content strategy and enablement engine that powers our highest-stakes executive moments—from global Executive Briefing Centers (EBCs) to bespoke leadership workshops. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Executive Engagement, you will equip Stripe leaders, account teams, and event hosts to clearly articulate Stripe as the complete financial infrastructure for the internet. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Develop Thought Leadership Narratives: Craft tailored, point-of-view-driven narratives and presentations for executive-level meetings, advisory boards, and Tier-1 convenings. 
 Drive Executive Briefing Center Enablement: Develop and scale sales enablement frameworks, messaging toolkits, and prep materials to empower account teams to lead impactful executive briefings. 
 Build Scalable Workshop Motions: Architect and scale interactive whiteboarding and workshop frameworks that simplify complex product architectures and showcase Stripe as a complete financial infrastructure. 
 Curate Executive Demo Library: Build, maintain, and package an executive-ready demo library—repurposing existing product assets into high-touch formats designed specifically for executive experiences. 
 Lead Speaker Training & Certification: Create and scale a formal speaker training and certification program to prepare Stripe executives and technical subject matter experts for high-profile speaking roles and EBC engagements. 
 Scale Content via AI: Design and deploy AI agents and workflows to automate content generation, personalize executive materials, and streamline enablement at scale. 
 
 Who you are 
 A crisp storyteller, strategic thinker, and enablement innovator. You are a sharp, driven problem-solver with a relentless bias for action—someone who isn't afraid to get scrappy and is energized by building new capabilities for growing teams. You excel at taking deep technical complexity—like global payments infrastructure and financial software—and turning it into elegant, high-impact stories for C-suite audiences. You understand how executive sales motions work and know how to build repeatable systems, scalable tools, and AI-driven workflows that elevate an entire organization’s narrative capabilities. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 10+ years of product marketing, solutions marketing, or executive enablement experience in B2B tech, SaaS, or fintech. 
 Proven track record building executive-level narratives and high-touch customer workshop motions. 
 Demonstrated experience designing and executing sales enablement programs, speaker training, or certification frameworks. 
 Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with extensive experience presenting to and prepping C-suite leaders. 
 Demonstrated success working cross-functionally across Product, Sales, and Field Marketing teams. 
 Bachelor's degree

jobs.excerpt:
We're transforming the grocery industry 
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. 
 Instacart is a Flex First team 
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Why this role is on the menu 
 Instacart's commercial event calendar, spanning premier industry tradeshows like Cannes Lions, Expo West, and Shoptalk Europe alongside owned executive programs and bespoke cultural hospitality experiences, needs dedicated, hands-on ownership for the next six months. Without this role, event logistics, vendor relationships, and cross-functional coordination across Sales, Corp Comms, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative go unmanaged at a critical point in our B2B growth. This contract role exists to ensure every Instacart presence at a major industry event is executed with precision, on budget, and with measurable impact. By the end of the engagement, Instacart's reputation as a sophisticated event marketer in the eCommerce, AdTech, and CPG space will be meaningfully advanced. 
   
 What you'll cook up in your first year 
 
 Instacart's B2B event calendar is executed flawlessly across premier tradeshows (Cannes Lions, Expo West, Shoptalk Europe), executive programs, and bespoke hospitality experiences, with every event delivered on time and within budget. 
 Event creative assets are produced in close partnership with marketing, creative, and sales teams, ensuring consistent brand representation across all touchpoints. 
 Project plans, timelines, and budgets are built and maintained per event, giving stakeholders across Sales, Corp Comms, Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative clear visibility and alignment throughout. 
 A reporting and measurement framework is in place that captures event performance and informs future investment decisions. 
 Vendor and contract relationships are managed efficiently, with invoicing and negotiations handled smoothly to keep event operations running without friction. 

 The secret ingredients we're looking for 
 Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) 
 
 5 to 10 years of B2B event marketing experience 
 Hands-on Cannes Lions experience required 
 Proven track record managing high-profile tradeshows and industry events 
 Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple events simultaneously in a fast-paced environment 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills 
 Experience with contract negotiation and vendor invoicing 
 Comfortable with administrative duties and operational support 
 Ability to travel 2 to 4 times during the contract period 
 
 Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications) 
 
 Experience with Cvent, Salesforce, Google Sheets, or Excel 
 Experience with events in the eCommerce, AdTech, and/or CPG marketing industries 
 Experience managing large-scale events (100 to 600+ attendees)

 Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please rea d more about our benefits offerings here . jobs.location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
jobs.excerpt:
We're transforming the grocery industry 
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. 
 Instacart is a Flex First team 
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Why this role is on the menu 
 Paid search is one of the highest-contributing channels to Instacart's growth, and with significant investment across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, the precision of day-to-day execution is what determines whether the program scales or stalls. The SEM team is small and high-performing, which means every team member carries real ownership over a complex, multi-million dollar program that directly drives new customer acquisition. This role exists to bring the operational rigor, analytical depth, and campaign management expertise needed to keep that program running with consistency, accuracy, and impact. 
   
 What you'll cook up in your first year 
 
 Paid search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads are executed with accuracy and consistency, driving reliable new customer acquisition at scale across multiple accounts simultaneously. 
 Multi-million dollar monthly budgets are paced and managed with precision, with spend alignment and campaign efficiency maintained across all accounts in close coordination with internal stakeholders. 
 Large-scale campaign structures, including keyword management, bid strategies, ad copy, landing pages, and audience targeting, are continuously optimized and maintained within established testing frameworks and operational playbooks. 
 Campaign performance is tracked, analyzed, and presented on a regular cadence, with insights surfaced proactively and campaign health issues identified and resolved before they impact results. 
 A/B tests and marketing experiments with Data Science, Analytics, and Product teams are supported with meticulous records of campaign changes, budget pacing, and performance trends. 

 The secret ingredients we're looking for 
 Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) 
 
 3-6 years of hands-on experience managing paid search campaigns directly within Google Ads and Microsoft Ads platforms. 
 Experience managing large paid search budgets, with exposure to programs involving $5M+ in monthly spend preferred. 
 Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience optimizing toward performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, ROI, LTV, and CAC. 
 Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for performance analysis, budget tracking, and reporting. 
 Proven ability to follow detailed operational processes and SOPs with consistency, accuracy, and a high attention to detail across complex, multi-account campaign structures. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting performance insights and updates to internal stakeholders. 
 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

 Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications) 
 
 Experience working within a structured, process-driven in-house marketing team or agency environment managing enterprise-scale SEM programs. 
 Familiarity with marketing measurement, attribution methodologies, and incrementality testing frameworks. 
 Experience supporting or collaborating on A/B experiments alongside analytics or data science teams.

This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here . Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia. 
 Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here .

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life.  ZoomInfo is growing and looking to add talented and passionate people to our Customer Success team! This individual will drive product adoption, retention, and growth by delivering high levels of business value, and cultivating deep customer relationships with some of the world’s most iconic companies currently using ZoomInfo. This Senior GTM Success Manager will be responsible for all aspects of strategic account partnerships, adoption and customer success planning. This position will develop and execute strategic account plans, deliver business reviews, and drive overall customer value for our customers. We provide world-class training while surrounded by incredible co-workers and leaders who have a vested interest in seeing you thrive.  
 What You'll Do: 
 
 Act as an extension of our enterprise customers, being a proactive advocate within ZoomInfo and our customer base to accomplish defined objectives 
 Develop a trusted advisor relationship with strategic customer stakeholders and executive sponsors to drive product adoption and ensure they are leveraging ZoomInfo to achieve full business value 
 Proactively grow the breadth and depth of strategic relationships within customers 
 Closely manage and nurture accounts to identify and eliminate risk of attrition 
 Partner with internal ZoomInfo stakeholders to align account activities with the strategic customer’s business case and strategy 
 Establish trusted relationships with customers, sustaining relationships through the full life cycle of the subscription ensuring their success 
 Ensure customers are aware of and educated on new features and releases 
 Monitor and identify adoption and utilization trends, provide recommendations based on risk and customers’ business needs 
 Identify renewal risk and collaborate with internal teams to remediate and ensure a successful renewal 
 Ensure customer feedback is clearly captured and conveyed internally to enable ongoing improvement of products and services 
 
 What You Will Bring: 
 
 2+ years of customer success, account management, or sales experience in a competitive SaaS environment 
 2+ years working with Mid-Market and Enterprise level accounts 
 Have a great understanding of world-class go-to-market process, including how Revenue Operations, Enablement Leaders, Sales Managers, Customer Success leaders and individual contributors think and operate 
 Excellent communication skills, including issue tracking, triaging and crisis management 
 Ability to efficiently manage multiple customer projects simultaneously 
 Communicates with internal and external customers and all levels of management 
 Effectively communicate technical information to non-technical audiences 
 Delivers informative, well-organized presentations 
 Understands how to communicate difficult/sensitive information tactfully 
 Continually seeks opportunities to increase customer satisfaction and deepen client relationships 
 Manages client expectations effectively 
 Self-motivated, collaborative and scrappy team player with innovative ideas to inspire customer loyalty and adoption 
 General understanding of sales methodologies and playbooks like Sandler, Winning By Design, MEDDIC a plus! 
 Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree preferred 
 Ability to work a minimum of three days per week from one of our office locations.  
 
 What’s In It For You: 
 We want our employees and their families to thrive. In addition to comprehensive benefits we offer holistic mind, body and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits here .  
 
 Incredibly strong onboarding program - be set up for success in your first 90 days 
 Ongoing training to help you grow 
 Market leading product offering (check our our long list of G2 awards) 
 Comprehensive Medical, Dental, Vision 
 Eligibility for Future Equity Awards 
 401k Matching (50% of the first 7% of your contribution) 
 12 weeks Parental Leave for primary or secondary caregivers 
 Family forming benefits up to $20k, plus discounts on a Care.com membership 
 Virgin Pulse Wellness Program 
 Optional add ons such as pet insurance, legal service support, and more! 
 
 This is a hybrid position, working a minimum of three days per week from one of our office locations - Waltham MA, Bethesda MD, or Vancouver WA

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are  
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to  hundreds of thousands of businesses  and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. 
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . 
 Hiring and how we work 
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!  
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.  . See yourself at Twilio 
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Sales Development Representative supporting our New Business and Strategic Sales organizations. 
 About the job 
 This position is needed to grow and develop pipeline for Twilio’s New Business and Strategic Sales teams. The Sales Development organization is a strategic component of Twilio’s overall go-to-market strategy. 
 As a team, we collaborate daily, push each other to do the best work of our lives, and bring an unparalleled level of energy and drive to our jobs. We’re looking for people who have a growth-oriented mindset and want to build their careers within Twilio. If this role excites you but you think you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply — we’re already looking forward to meeting you. 
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you’ll: 
 
 Break into new companies and markets using a multi-channel, value-based approach focused on building relationships and driving awareness of Twilio’s platform. 
 Receive all the necessary training and insights to confidently begin contacting prospects through Twilio’s SDR onboarding experience. 
 Achieve and exceed monthly goals for generating new business opportunities to fuel the sales pipeline. 
 Become a master of Salesforce, Outreach, Sales Navigator, and other tools essential for efficient workflows. 
 Research accounts to determine how Twilio’s solutions can provide value, then execute outbound dials, personalized emails, and social selling. 
 Work in partnership with Account Executives to develop account strategies, territory plans, and successfully generate new business opportunities 
 
 Qualifications  
 Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! 
 Required: 
 
 Growth-oriented and ready to build toward future leadership or customer-facing roles 
 Goal-oriented and biased toward action (our quota is the floor, not the ceiling!) 
 Excited to go above and beyond to delight prospects through creative, strategic, highly personalized outreach 
 Comfortable with change and energized by a fast-moving environment 
 Enjoy variety and creativity in your day-to-day workflow 
 Have a demonstrated ability to navigate challenges with resilience 
 Embrace responsibility and enjoy partnering with Account Executives as part of a team   
 
 Desired: 
 
 1+ year of customer-facing experience 
 
 Location 
 This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, IL, MA, MD, NJ, NY, OR, PA, RI, TX, VA, WA, or Washington DC. 
 Travel  
 We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. 
 What We Offer

 Some of the things we look for: 
 
 Have an innate curiosity about how data is changing the world

 Thrive in the unknown – and have a track record to prove it 
 Examples of where you have displayed your passion and perseverance to accomplish a long term goal 
 You want a career in sales and see this as an excellent way to learn and prove yourself 
 Business Acumen - you have built this through academic or professional experiences 
 You are an Entrepreneur at heart

 Where could this role be based? 
 
 We are headquartered in the financial district of Boston MA. This role is a hybrid model and therefore 4-5 days a week will be expected to be in the Boston office.

jobs.excerpt:
About Gusto 
 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve. 
   All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy . 
   AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process. About the Role 
 This is your chance to shape the foundation of a fast-growing, high-impact part of Gusto's business as a Senior Sales Operations Analyst supporting our Health Insurance (HI) Sales team. You'll build the insights and AI-powered solutions that make a large, high-volume sales organization, supporting 80+ reps across two segments. You'll sit at the intersection of data, process, and execution; you'll turn real sales challenges into the tools, reports, automations, and workflows that move the numbers. 
 You'll help grow a business segment that serves tens of thousands of small businesses through smarter, data-driven sales strategies. If you thrive where analytics, problem-solving, and supporting others meet, this role offers ownership, visibility, and the chance to influence how Gusto sells health insurance. 
 About the Team 
 The HI Sales Operations team partners closely with sales leadership to support two dynamic, fast-moving sales teams that contribute meaningfully to Gusto's growth. We think of ourselves as builders, problem solvers, and strategic partners; we turn uncertainty into clarity and fragmented processes into scalable, repeatable systems. 
 Our work spans quotas, pipeline health, forecasting, process design, data integrity, account and territory administration, go-to-market strategy, and increasingly, AI-driven optimization. We value curiosity, open communication, and a commitment to helping 80+ sales reps operate efficiently and confidently. 
 Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day 
 Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting 
 
 Build, automate, and maintain reports and dashboards that track sales performance, funnel metrics, pipeline health, SLAs, and rep productivity; keep definitions consistent and documentation clear. 
 Partner with RevOps, Finance, Marketing, and Analytics to produce operational reporting, revenue insights, and forecasting models across the weekly forecast, monthly reviews, and QBR cadence. 
 Own metric definitions and data accuracy so leaders trust the numbers they act on. 
 
 Drive AI Strategy for Sales 
 
 Identify and prototype AI and automation tools, such as content generation, analytics copilots, and call coaching, that remove manual friction from the sales process. 
 Partner with Sales, BizTech, Product, and Enablement to embed AI into daily sales workflows, improving both efficiency and effectiveness. 
 Source and lead net-new AI and automation projects, connecting data insights to process improvements that lift rep productivity. 
 
 Process Design & Continuous Improvement 
 
 Examine workflows and rep performance to identify bottlenecks; recommend and implement process and automation changes that improve conversion, efficiency, and the rep experience. 
 Partner with Sales Enablement to document processes, build playbooks, and drive adoption of new tools and workflows. 
 
 Operational Support & Problem-Solving 
 
 Provide day-to-day support to HI Sales leadership and reps: ad hoc data requests, process issues, and one-off investigations. 
 Own account and territory administration as the business evolves, assignment and coverage upkeep, book reassignments for leave and departures, large-scale account rerouting, and segment reclassification, supported by lead-routing and round-robin automation. 
 Support territory, quota, and coverage planning, plus monthly sales-compensation reconciliation. 
 Troubleshoot reporting issues, broken workflows, missing CRM data, and gaps in pipeline visibility with fast, accurate fixes. 
 
 Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication 
 
 Work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Finance, BizTech, and Product to keep everyone aligned and remove obstacles to progress. 
 Translate sales challenges into clear business requirements; partner cross-functionally to design solutions and durable improvements. 
 Keep stakeholders aligned with clear, regular updates to managers and senior leadership on timelines, risks, and outcomes. 
 Act as a trusted advisor, bringing structure, insight, and clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. 
 
 Here’s what we're looking for 
 
 5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment. 
 Strong Salesforce proficiency; you can spot data issues, audit pipeline problems, manage account ownership and routing, and build reports and dashboards that reps and leaders actually use. 
 Analytical depth across Salesforce reports and dashboards, SQL, Tableau or Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets. 
 Hands-on experience with forecasting, pipeline management, and territory or quota planning on a recurring cadence; for example, a weekly forecast feeding monthly reviews and QBRs. 
 Comfort evaluating AI and automation tools and prototyping simple workflows to improve productivity. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication; you simplify complex information and create alignment from frontline reps to senior directors. 
 A first-principles problem solver who breaks down ambiguous issues, tests hypotheses, and builds structured solutions. 
 Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, you manage multiple projects and recurring workflows while protecting data quality and operational reliability. 
 A strong partner to sales, with a track record supporting teams that have competing, fast-changing priorities. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Experience in payroll, HR tech, or SMB SaaS go-to-market motions. 
 Experience supporting a regulated or compliance-driven sales segment such as health insurance or benefits. 
 Experience designing or implementing automations, AI workflows, or similar tooling. 
 A track record of building cross-functional relationships across Sales, BizTech, and Analytics. 
 Experience building systems to support new or evolving sales motions, with comfort in fast iteration and testing in live sales environments.

 You'll help grow revenue from Gusto's existing customer base through upsells and cross-sells. If you thrive where analytics, problem-solving, and supporting others meet, this role offers ownership, visibility, and the chance to influence how Gusto expands its relationship with the small businesses it already serves. 
 About the Team 
 The Expansion Sales Operations team partners closely with sales leadership to support three dynamic, fast-moving sales teams that contribute meaningfully to Gusto's growth. We think of ourselves as builders, problem solvers, and strategic partners; we turn uncertainty into clarity and fragmented processes into scalable, repeatable systems. 
 Our work spans pacing and pipeline forecasting, quotas, trigger and backlog management, process design, data integrity, account and territory administration, rules of engagement, and increasingly, AI-driven optimization. We value curiosity, open communication, and a commitment to helping our reps operate efficiently and confidently across a multi-product, multi-team motion. 
 Here's what you'll do day-to-day 
 Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting 
 
 Build, automate, and maintain reports and dashboards that track pacing, funnel metrics, trigger and backlog health, SLAs, and rep productivity; keep definitions consistent and documentation clear. 
 Own the weekly forecast, CFQ closed-won ARR pacing, and probability-weighted pipeline forecast, feeding the Weekly Business Review (WBR) and Weekly Forecast Review (WFR) cadence for sales and executive leadership. 
 Partner with Finance and Analytics to produce operational reporting and revenue insights across dials, connects, lead passes, self-generated opportunities, and book coverage. 
 Own metric definitions and data accuracy so leaders trust the numbers they act on. 
 
 Drive AI Strategy for Sales 
 
 Identify and prototype AI and automation tools, such as process automation, analytics copilots, and call coaching, that remove manual friction from the sales process. 
 Partner with Sales, BizTech, Product, and Enablement to embed AI into daily sales workflows, improving both efficiency and effectiveness. 
 Source and lead net-new AI and automation projects, connecting data insights to process improvements that lift rep productivity. 
 
 Process Design & Continuous Improvement 
 
 Examine workflows and rep performance to identify bottlenecks; recommend and implement process and automation changes that improve conversion, efficiency, and the rep experience. 
 Evaluate Rules of Engagement (ROE) requests and comp exception asks, applying clear rules and precedent to produce fair, consistent, and binding rulings. 
 Partner with Sales Enablement to document processes, build playbooks, and drive adoption of new tools and workflows. 
 
 Operational Support & Problem-Solving 
 
 Provide day-to-day support to Expansion Sales leadership and reps: ad hoc data requests, process issues, and one-off investigations. 
 Own account and territory administration as the business evolves: assignment and coverage upkeep, book reassignments for leave and departures, large-scale account rerouting, and segment reclassification, supported by lead-routing and round-robin (ChiliPiper) automation. 
 Support onboarding and offboarding for new hires and departing reps, including roster updates, router mapping, and leave-of-absence (LOA) processing. 
 Troubleshoot reporting issues, broken workflows, missing CRM data, and gaps in pipeline visibility with fast, accurate fixes — including closed-won opportunities that didn't sync and ARR discrepancies. 
 
 Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication 
 
 Work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Finance, BizTech, and Product to keep everyone aligned and remove obstacles to progress. 
 Translate sales challenges into clear business requirements; partner cross-functionally to design solutions and durable improvements. 
 Keep stakeholders aligned with clear, regular updates to managers and senior leadership on timelines, risks, and outcomes. 
 Act as a trusted advisor, bringing structure, insight, and clarity to complex or ambiguous problems. 
 
 Here's what we're looking for 
 
 5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment. 
 Strong Salesforce proficiency; you can spot data issues, audit pipeline problems, manage account ownership and routing, and build reports and dashboards that reps and leaders actually use. 
 Analytical depth across Salesforce reports and dashboards, SQL, Tableau or Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets. 
 Hands-on experience with forecasting, pipeline management, and territory or quota planning on a recurring cadence; for example, a weekly forecast feeding monthly reviews and QBRs. 
 Comfort evaluating AI and automation tools and prototyping simple workflows to improve productivity. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication; you simplify complex information and create alignment from frontline reps to senior directors. 
 A first-principles problem solver who breaks down ambiguous issues, tests hypotheses, and builds structured solutions. 
 Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, you manage multiple projects and recurring workflows while protecting data quality and operational reliability. 
 A strong partner to sales, with a track record supporting teams that have competing, fast-changing priorities. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Experience supporting an expansion, upsell, or cross-sell motion into an existing customer base, rather than net-new acquisition.

 Track record of shaping GTM strategy in ambiguous yet highly ambitious environments — 0-to-1 products, new markets, or building new motions within an existing company 
 Ability to move between strategic planning and hands-on execution—comfortable with ambiguity and bias toward action 
 Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; adept at influencing across Sales, Product, and Marketing 
 Deep experience with customer segmentation, positioning, pricing, and GTM planning 
 Experience in SMB, fintech, HR/benefits/payroll tech, or a complex multi-audience business is a plus 
 Highly AI fluent; able to build AI systems and unlock new ways of working through AI
