At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew. 
 We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization. 
 To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success. 
 Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture. 
 If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you. At Braze, Product Marketing sits at the center of how we bring our platform to market—shaping the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that connect what we build to the value our customers feel. As part of our Product Marketing team, you'll own narratives and GTM  for the strategic technology partnerships that extend what's possible on our platform. This is a role for a builder and a storyteller: someone energized by turning complex offerings into clear, compelling go-to-market programs, and who thrives working shoulder-to-shoulder with teams across Product, Sales, Partnership, and Marketing to bring them to life. 
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 You will translate Braze's strategic technology partnerships into differentiated messaging, joint go-to-market programs, and field-ready assets that ladder up to our core platform narrative. 
 This is an individual contributor role focused on strong PMM craft and cross-functional execution. You'll bring a clear understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, and you'll work closely with internal cross-functional teams including Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to take initiatives from messaging through to field readiness. 
 GTM Strategy & Messaging  
 
 Develop GTM strategy based on joint business plans for strategic technology partnerships in collaboration with partner leads 
 Own the messaging architecture for Braze's strategic technology partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers and data platforms), ensuring each partnership ladders up to our core platform narrative and customer engagement story 
 Translate platform integrations into clear, differentiated value propositions with defined customer use cases and competitive angles 
 Work with Core Product Marketing to ensure technology partners are reflected accurately in product launches, campaigns, and core messaging 
 
 GTM Execution & Enablement 
 
 Drive joint go-to-market and co-marketing programs with technology platform partners, coordinating timelines and deliverables across internal teams 
 Drive partner launch motions end-to-end: messaging, packaging, enablement materials, and field readiness 
 Build and deliver core assets and enablement that actually get used in the field 
 Track performance and adoption, and report results back to cross-functional stakeholders 
 
 Cross-Functional Execution 
 
 Work closely with Product, GTM Strategy, Sales, Marketing, and Partnership to align on priorities and execute against them 
 Partner with Sales and the field to support active deals, customer conversations, and positioning 
 
 What Success Looks Like 
 In your first year, success means: 
 
 A repeatable launch and enablement motion for technology platform partnerships, with integrations reflected consistently across launches, campaigns, and core messaging 
 Trusted, productive relationships across Product, Sales, Partners, Marketing, and Services—you're the person teams pull in early 
 
 WHO YOU ARE 
 
 A storyteller. You turn complex offerings and integrations into clear, differentiated narratives that resonate with buyers and the field alike 
 A builder. You're comfortable with ambiguity and energized by creating structure, frameworks, and repeatable motions where none existed 
 A collaborator. You're a sleeves-rolled-up, low-ego operator who brings cross-functional teams along and gets things shipped without direct authority 
 GTM-fluent. You understand how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners and how to execute them in a fast-moving, matrixed organization 
 
 What You Bring to the Team 
 
 7–10+ years in product and/or partner marketing at a growing B2B technology company, with strong product marketing (PMM) craft at the core 
 A clear, practical understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, including joint GTM programs, co-marketing motions, and integration launches 
 Strong PMM fundamentals: messaging frameworks, competitive positioning, narrative development, and the ability to translate complex offerings and integrations into clear, buyer-ready stories 
 Experience marketing technology platform partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers, data platforms, and the broader SaaS/martech ecosystem) 
 Experience building sales and enablement content—solution briefs, battle cards, decks, playbooks—that gets adopted and used by the field 
 A proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and execute without direct authority, navigating a matrixed organization to get things shipped 
 Excellent communicator, comfortable presenting to internal stakeholders and partners 
 
 Nice to Have 
 
 Experience in customer engagement, marketing technology, CDP, or adjacent data/SaaS categories

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Advertising
jobs.excerpt:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Marketing team helps deeply understand customer audiences and market dynamics, influence the development of the right products, build sustainable and customer-aligned monetization models, and drive awareness, adoption, and usage across OpenAI’s products and platform.

We take a data-driven approach to understand markets, develop monetization strategies, and uncover customer needs that shape product strategy and messaging. We partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design to deliver a cohesive end-to-end customer experience and lead go-to-market efforts for new product launches across channels.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Advertising to bring together advertiser insights, market understanding, and product knowledge to shape positioning, inform product priorities, and deliver go-to-market initiatives that drive adoption and measurable business impact.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Partnerships to understand advertiser needs, translate complex AI capabilities into clear customer value, and bring new products and features to market. This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, independently navigates ambiguity, and brings cross-functional partners together to deliver results.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Define the product and marketing strategy for a component of OpenAI’s advertising business in partnership with cross-functional partners

 - Develop a deep understanding of advertisers through customer research, market analysis, and competitive insights, identifying opportunities to improve positioning, adoption, and product-market fit.

 - Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating complex capabilities into compelling narratives for different advertiser audiences and use cases.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering to bring advertiser needs and market insights into roadmap discussions and product decisions.

 - Develop and drive go-to-market plans for new products and features, owning marketing execution from planning through launch and ongoing adoption.

 - Create advertiser-facing content and sales enablement materials, including product narratives, sales decks, one-pagers, FAQs, and launch communications.

 - Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Data Science, and Analytics to define success metrics, assess launch and adoption performance, and turn findings into improvements.

 - Surface advertiser concerns and launch risks related to performance, safety, policy, and trust, working with the relevant teams to address them in launch plans and customer communications.

 - Align cross-functional partners around priorities, responsibilities, and timelines, making thoughtful tradeoffs and resolving blockers within your initiatives.

 - Build repeatable approaches to launches, messaging, and enablement, sharing learnings and mentoring peers to improve the team’s storytelling and execution.

YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU…

 - Have experience independently developing product and marketing strategies and bringing products to market, particularly in advertising, marketing technology, platforms, or data and AI.

 - Have experience in structured problem solving environments including but not limited to strategy/management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy and venture capital

 - Understand advertiser goals and the advertising ecosystem, including measurement, targeting and relevance, creative, auctions, and performance tradeoffs.

 - Can turn customer research and market insights into clear positioning, actionable go-to-market plans, and recommendations that inform product priorities.

 - Communicate clearly and persuasively, translating technical concepts into differentiated customer value for a range of audiences.

 - Use qualitative and quantitative evidence—including customer interviews, surveys, adoption data, and experiments—to make decisions and improve results.

 - Bring structured problem solving and strong judgment to ambiguous challenges, independently setting priorities and managing initiatives from strategy through execution.

 - Build effective partnerships across Product, Engineering, Sales, and other teams, influencing decisions and driving alignment without formal authority.

 - Enjoy improving how teams work, sharing your expertise, and helping peers strengthen their craft.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Radar
jobs.excerpt:
About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 Our Product Marketing team’s mission is to generate customer insights that inform Stripe’s product strategy, and lead go-to-market for our suite of products. Product Marketing is a highly cross-functional role at Stripe, partnering closely with Product and Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, Demand Generation and Campaigns to name a few. Different from many other Product Marketing teams, our team works across the entire product lifecycle, from helping shape the product, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing product adoption post-launch. We also drive both self-serve and sales-sold marketing efforts. 
 We’re seeking a product marketer to drive the end-to-end GTM strategy and execution for Radar. As a Product Marketing Manager, you will shape the product roadmap, own product-level messaging and positioning, create differentiated content for events and presentations, support product launches, and enable sales. Reporting to the Fraud and Risk PMM Lead, you’ll partner with product and sales teams to drive awareness and adoption in a rapidly evolving market. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Serve as an early strategic partner on new offerings — shaping product direction, defining target segments, and building the GTM foundation (positioning, packaging, pricing narrative) from zero to one. 
 Drive end-to-end product launches, including define audience segments, gather user insights, craft launch narratives, inform pricing and packaging, ensure cross-functional readiness, and execute launch activities 
 Develop differentiated messaging and positioning, equip GTM teams with knowledge and content to sell and market effectively   
 Create high-impact thought leadership content 
 Work closely with product, sales, data science, pricing and cross-functional marketing teams to identify new opportunities to drive awareness, demand, and adoption of our products and build the right marketing strategies  
 
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.  
 Minimum requirements 
 
 5+ years of product marketing or growth marketing experience at a technology company 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience translating technical features into benefits for a technical audience 
 Track record of working cross-functionally across product, sales, and growth teams to drive business outcomes

jobs.title: Product Manager - GTM
jobs.excerpt:
At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24/7, driving both new business and repeat customers. 
 In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business. 
 Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2. 
 Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you're hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won't find a better place to learn and accelerate your career. About this opportunity: 
 As a Product Manager on the Internal Tools Team, you will define and build the systems, platforms, and automation that power how our GTM teams operate and engage with customers. Your work will directly impact sales performance, customer retention, and operational efficiency across the business. 
 This role is both strategic and execution-focused: you will own the vision, roadmap, and outcomes of internal products that enable teams to execute on company-wide strategy at scale. 
 What you will be doing: 
 
 Product Vision and Roadmap: Define and drive the vision and roadmap for internal platforms and automation that elevate team performance, streamline workflows, and enable more effective customer engagement. 
 AI and Automation Integration: Identify and implement opportunities to apply AI and automation within internal workflows, reducing manual effort, improving decision-making, and increasing the quality and consistency of customer interactions. 
 Zero to One Product Development and Ownership: Lead the end-to-end development of new internal products, platforms, and systems, from concept through launch. Own the adoption, performance, and measurable impact on key business outcomes. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Customer Success, Onboarding, Support, Finance, and Legal teams to identify needs, define requirements, and ensure successful rollout and adoption of internal tools. Act as a product evangelist internally and externally, ensuring buy-in across the organization. 
 Customer Insights and Feedback: Engage directly with internal users to gather feedback and insights that will drive product improvements and future innovations. 
 Data-Driven Decisions: Leverage product, usage, and other business performance data to inform decisions and maximize impact. Continuously analyze product metrics and user behavior to uncover new opportunities for growth. 
 Executive Communication: Communicate effectively with executive leadership, demonstrating strong executive presence and the ability to influence strategic decisions through clear and compelling product insights and recommendations. 
 
 What you should have: 
 
 4+ years of product management experience with a track record of successfully delivering web-based products, ideally in SaaS or communication tools. 
 High agency and ownership, with a willingness to tackle problems end-to-end, learning what’s necessary along the way to ensure successful outcomes. 
 Enthusiasm for AI, with a solid understanding of AI systems, including autonomous agents and their practical applications. 
 Proven experience in fast-paced technical environments, adept at working with cross-functional teams to drive product vision, define requirements, and guide projects through key milestones. 
 Demonstrated ability to manage the entire product lifecycle, from concept to launch, and continuously optimize for growth and customer success. 
 Strong collaboration skills, with a proven ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, design, AI, and marketing teams to deliver high-impact products. 
 Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience in SQL and data visualization tools to drive data-informed product decisions and measure success. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate product strategies, updates, and insights to a wide range of audiences, including executive leadership. 
 Experience leading the development of new products from scratch, with a strong bias toward action and execution in dynamic, fast-moving environments. 
 A passion for driving customer engagement and helping local businesses succeed through innovative tools and experiences. 
 
 What we hope you have: 
 
 You are a first principles thinker who isn't just building features but solving problems 
 The desire to move at a breakneck pace 
 A refusal to accept previous norms knowing what is now possible with the use of AI 
 
 Why you’ll love working here: 
 
 You’ll own a high-impact product area with real autonomy: the roadmap, strategy, and day-to-day direction for Podium’s marketing tooling ecosystem. 
 You’ll work on meaningful problems at the intersection of AI, internal tools, and marketing, with the chance to bring structure and innovation to a space that needs clear ownership. 
 You’ll collaborate closely with highly engaged stakeholders across marketing and operations, and play a central role in improving how teams work internally. 
 
 Benefits 
 
 Open and transparent culture 
 Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage 
 Paid maternity and paternity leave 
 Fertility Benefits 
 Generous vacation time, plus three 4-day summer holiday weekends 
 Excellent medical, dental, and vision benefits 
 401k Plan 
 Bi-annual swag drops with cool Podium gear and apparel 
 A stellar HQ (Utah) gym with local professional coaches and classes offered 
 Onsite HQ (Utah) child care center, subsidized for employees 
 
 Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.

jobs.title: Events Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: 
 Interested in joining a top-notch marketing team? We are looking for an energetic, highly organized, team player who loves a fast-paced environment and thrives on results. In this role, you will meticulously plan, execute & measure new events and programs for Samsara. These events can include industry trade shows, hosted events, customer and executive experiences, regional summits, educational programs and workshops, strategic sponsorships, partner activations, and other high-impact field marketing programs. 
 This is a highly cross-functional role that requires close partnership across Sales, Account Development, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations & Product Management. You should be results-driven, detail-oriented, and passionate about driving business impact. This is a fast-growing area of the business that plays a strategic role in our future success. 
 This is a remote role open to candidates based in Mexico City and will require travel up to 50% in Mexico. 
 You should apply if: 
 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
 You are the architect of your own career:  If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. 
 You’re energized by our opportunity:  The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. 
 You want to be with the best:  At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.  
 
 In this role, you will:  
 
 Own trade shows and hosted events strategy, planning, execution, and success for a strategic company industry vertical, territory or segment 
 Execute end-to-end event program management and logistics from initial planning to post-event program follow up, including vendor management, budget management, event promotions, sales enablement, data cleansing/tracking, KPI measurement, and maintenance of all event assets 
 Manage event budget forecast and reporting, evaluate and communicate results against goals, and generate learnings for improvement 
 Facilitate timely event lead processing within Salesforce, measure event impact, and develop post-event reports and communicate insights 
 Own project management tools, documentation, event calendar, and processes used for managing event marketing programs & tradeshows 
 Bring energy, creativity, and new ideas to build a successful event program 
 Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 
 
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
 
 3+ years of professional experience in field marketing, event marketing, or integrated marketing, with demonstrated ownership of customer-facing programs from strategy and planning through execution and post-event measurement. 
 Proven ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously in a fast-paced environment, navigate shifting priorities, and consistently deliver against deadlines without compromising execution quality. 
 Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with demonstrated experience partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product Marketing, agencies, vendors, and other internal and external stakeholders. 
 Excellent project management and organizational skills, with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to build scalable processes, documentation, timelines, and operational frameworks. 
 Proficient using a CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and/or Marketing Automation platforms. 
 Must be fluent in Spanish and English. 
 Based in/near Mexico City and comfortable going into the office when needed. 
 Ability to travel up to 50% for events. 
 
 An ideal candidate also has: 
 
 A positive attitude, a team player mentality, and an unmatched love and enthusiasm for all things events. 
 A demand generation mindset for event assessment, planning, and execution. 
 Experience communicating with and presenting to senior executives, VIPs, customers, and partners. 
 Experience managing strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and third-party event relationships to maximize brand presence and business impact. 
 Outstanding skills in problem-solving, project management, creative thinking, written/verbal communication, and presenting. 
 A self-starter mentality with impeccable organization and a strong attention to detail. 
 The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. Annual Base Salary $569,075 — $669,500 MXN Total Rewards 
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. 
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. 
 Flexible Working  
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead, GTM Strategy - Claude for Knowledge Work
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 There are close to a billion knowledge workers in the world, and only a small fraction of them have discovered what it feels like to work alongside AI that actually raises their game. Getting the rest of the way there isn't a single campaign or launch — it's an integrated marketing and growth motion: the right story, reaching the right persona, backed by activation and campaign work that turns a first try into habitual use. That's what this role owns. 
 We're looking for a Product Marketing Lead to own the GTM Strategy and integrated growth motion that makes Claude for Knowledge Work — chat, Cowork, Claude for Office, Tag and more — the default AI collaborator for knowledge workers. 
 You'll define the Marketing & growth strategy by segment for our core knowledge-work products, and coordinate the work streams that acquire and activate both users and accounts and drive their success. This role provides direction, coordination, and fuel across Demand Generation, Growth, Brand, Events, Campaigns, Field Marketing, and Success. 
 This is a GTM-oriented product marketer: deep in messaging and product truth, expressed through narrative content, campaigns, activation programs, and community. You'll build and run programs personally from day one, backed by many internal teams. 
 If you've owned an awareness-to-success marketing motions end to end for a product line, know how to turn product truth into content and campaigns that land with various segments and personas, and want to build the motion that gets millions of knowledge workers to change how they work, this role is for you. 
 Key responsibilities 

 Define the Marketing and growth strategy, segment by segment. Build a marketing plan per priority segment or function, prioritizing where to lead first and what to deliberately not do yet. 

 Set the content direction for Claude for Knowledge Work. Shape flagship narrative content based on the plan and campaign needs, building on the messaging and launch foundations owned by Core PMM. 

 Turn activation into a flywheel inside enterprise accounts. Identify and activate champions, coordinate workshops and webinars, and run lifecycle programs for various personas inside top accounts, inspiring knowledge workers to raise their ambitions and deliver more impact with Claude. 

 Own the flagship acquisition and activation campaigns. Define and run the "Hand off your tasks to Claude" integrated programs, choosing channels and activations that fit the audience. 

 Inform the digital, social, and field motions. Shape the Knowledge Work digital, social, and influencer motion — ops, finance, legal, marketing, and productivity creators — and our social presence in this space. 

 Coordinate without owning. Provide direction, coordination, and fuel across Demand Generation, Growth, Brand, Events, Campaigns, Field Marketing, and Success, so the growth motion moves as one program without duplicating any team's mandate. 

 Build and ship the work yourself. Operate as an individual contributor in year one — write the plans, build the campaigns, and ship the content directly, with room to grow a team as the motion matures. 

 Report on what the motion is actually driving. Track and share progress against awareness and preference, growth (WAUs and enterprise account depth), revenue contribution, and campaign efficiency. 

 Minimum qualifications 

 Have experience creating marketing programs for functional personas, whether users or buyers (e.g., Operations, Finance, Legal, Sales) 

 Excel at cross-functional collaboration, with a track record of driving work through influence across Demand Generation, Growth, Brand, Events, Campaigns, Field Marketing, and Success, without direct authority over any of them 

 Possess strong storytelling and content instincts, with a track record of flagship narrative content such as executive series or customer story programs 

 Demonstrate grit and leadership, with a track record of driving results in ambitious, high-scale, high-velocity environments 

 Are comfortable operating autonomously as an IC in year one, building and shipping plans, campaigns, and content directly rather than through a team 

 Preferred qualifications 
 
 10+ years of growth and product marketing and/or demand gen experience for portfolio or product-line scope 
 
 Experience marketing a productivity, collaboration, or AI-powered enterprise product to knowledge workers, as distinct from developers 

 A background running community, influencer, or creator programs for a B2B audience 

 Experience building unaided awareness and preference for a specific product name or term within a category where the parent brand already has strong general awareness — building a name, not a category, from scratch 

 Experience reading and responding to competitive dynamics in a fast-moving market 

 Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least 2 days a week. We encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. 
 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $400,000 — $400,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
About Starburst 
 Starburst delivers enterprise intelligence at scale by giving organizations secure, governed access to all their data, wherever it lives. Built for distributed data environments, Starburst helps enterprises power AI and analytics without the cost and complexity of traditional data consolidation. With open standards including Trino and Apache Iceberg, Starburst enables trusted access to complete enterprise context while helping organizations avoid vendor lock-in. Leading global enterprises trust Starburst to fuel AI, analytics, and enterprise intelligence. Learn more at starburst.ai . About the role 
 The Field Marketing Manager will be responsible for supporting and executing Field Marketing events and programs for both prospects and customers to support business growth.  This role will support the creation and execution of customer and prospect programs geared toward executive decision-makers and curated executive-level field marketing events with a focus on pipeline generation. The role will support tactical items that align with the Regional Sales Leadership, Regional Sales teams, as well as Marketing leadership. The successful candidate will be expected to collaborate and execute while maintaining a metric-driven success criteria and approach. 
 As a Field Marketing Manager at Starburst you will :  
 
 Support the planning and execution of field marketing programs and events that align with Starburst’s broader marketing and sales objectives, ensuring flawless logistics, strong cross-team collaboration, and impactful experiences that help generate pipeline and strengthen customer relationships. 
 Plan and execute field marketing programs that support regional pipeline goals. 
 Partner with sales to identify priorities, target accounts, and event opportunities. 
 Manage in-person and virtual events, roundtables, sponsorships, and customer programs. 
 Collaborate with partner marketing, product marketing, and content teams on campaign execution. 
 Track program performance, report results, and recommend optimizations. 
 Own event logistics, budgets, timelines, and vendor coordination. 
 Support sales enablement with event descriptions, talking points, and follow-up materials. 
 
 Some of the things we look for: 
 
 3+ years of experience in field marketing, demand generation, or related B2B marketing roles. 
 Strong project management and event execution skills. 
 Ability to collaborate across sales, marketing, and external partners. 
 Experience with pipeline-focused marketing programs and performance reporting. 
 Willingness to travel for field events. 
 Highly detail-oriented and creative, thriving in fast-paced, collaborative environments. 
 Passionate about creative thinking and experiential event planning , with a focus on delivering memorable, measurable, and impactful experiences. 
 Experience in B2B software, data, or infrastructure marketing. 
 Familiarity with Salesforce, marketing automation tools, and event platforms. 
 Experience supporting regional or partner-led programs. 
 
 Where could this role be based? 
 
 Boston, MA 
 Starburst is dedicated to maintaining fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range provided for this role reflects the minimum and maximum targets for candidates across all U.S. locations and could be inclusive of variable compensation, such as commission or bonus. All employees receive equity packages (ISOs) and have access to a comprehensive benefits offering. Actual compensation packages are determined based on relevant skills, experience, education and training, and specific work location. For more information, connect with the recruiting team or Hiring Manager during the process as they can provide more detailed information about the salary range. Pay Range $107,000 — $137,000 USD Build your career at Starburst 
 All-Stars have the opportunity and freedom to realize their true potential. By building alongside top talent, we’re empowered to take ownership of our careers and drive meaningful change. Anchored in industry-proven technology and unprecedented success, All-Stars are taking on the challenge everyday to disrupt our industry –  and the future.  
 Our global workforce is supported by a competitive Total Rewards program that reflects our commitment to a rewarding and supportive work environment. This includes a variety of benefits like competitive pay, attractive stock grants, flexible paid time off, and more.  
 We are committed to fostering an intentional, inclusive, and diverse culture that drives deep engagement, authentic belonging, and an exceptional All-Star experience. We believe that diversity of thought, perspective, background and experience will enable us to own what we do, drive our success and empower our All-Stars to show up authentically. 
 Starburst provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state  or local laws.

jobs.title: Go-To-Market (GTM) Digital Natives Program Leader
jobs.excerpt:
SLSQ127R420 
 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered. 
 As the GTM Digital Native Programs Leader , you will operate as the de facto COO and scale pipeline and consumption for the high-growth Databricks’ Digital Native vertical. You will partner in a "two-in-a-box" model with the Industry GTM Leader to translate strategy into durable, repeatable commercial execution across a rapidly scaling global field organization. You will work closely with sales and field engineering leaders to ideate, build, execute, and scale global programs.  
 You will play a critical role in shaping Databricks’ growth trajectory. You will be part of a lean GTM leadership that powers sellers to deliver measurable business outcomes through scale & leverage. You will be the lead orchestrator for your industry vertical, at the center of a mandate to inspire executives, drive industry outcomes, and unleash Databricks’ partner ecosystem in the high-growth SaaS space.  
 The Impact You Will Have 
 Strategy & Operating Model 
 
 Operating Model Ownership: Own and implement end-to-end op-model (across Sales, FE, Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Partners) in a consistent global approach. 
 Product-GTM Strategy: Inform the annual Digital Native strategy by synthesizing product telemetry and engineering roadmaps with field signals to identify Big Bets in the digital natives space. 
 Data-Driven Product Feedback: Synthesize learnings from internal (field, product, engineering, developer relations) & external (customer, partner, developers) stakeholders into durable best practices  
 
 Market Presence & Influence 
 
 Internal Executive Influence: Wield two-way influence on Databricks’ Field (Sales, FE, Business Dev), Product & Engineering leadership: i.e., reflect industry signals in product roadmaps, as well as translate product activation goals into verticalized industry programs 
 Market Presence: Own and engage with technical & business customer and partner executives, build market presence to uncover signals on technical friction, business value and Databricks differentiators. 

 Industry Evangelism: Serve as a visible evangelist & thought leader (e.g., open source advocacy, scaling AI adoption), representing Databricks’ at key customer, partner, industry and developer forums 
 
 Execution & Accountability 
 
 Full-Funnel Program Design: Select & design the industry’s programs across products (and verticalize product programs) across the full funnel: demand generation → pipe creation & progression → consumption 
 Asset Creation: Create high-quality and scalable program assets that will be used by the full field (Sales, FE, BD, Marketing, Ecosystem) at scale 

 Field Activation & Community: Drive continuous field adoption of program assets and outcomes by cross-pollinating best practices across product and field teams in high-impact community cadences. 
 Ecosystem Integration: Collaborate with the partnership, ISV, and Data Marketplace teams to drive adoption of a seamless, interconnected data-sharing ecosystem. 

 Outcome Measurement: Deliver commercial outcomes by establishing measurement and monitoring systems that track product telemetry, industry & partner program performance. 

 Executive Accountability: Drive cross-functional leadership accountability for program adoption and outcomes through continuous monitoring and executive influence. 
 
 What We Look For 
 Strategic & Operational Mindset 
 
 COO Mindset: Proven ability to act as the operational backbone of a business vertical, focusing on pipeline health, organizational efficiency, and execution. 
 Strategic Execution: A track record of defining and translating complex industry strategies into durable, "field-ready" commercial motions for large organizations. 
 Programmatic Vision: Experience developing global, scalable GTM frameworks - moving beyond "one-off" deals to create a scalable engine for growth. 
 
 Technical & Domain Expertise 
 
 Technical Chops: Technical knowledge on Databricks critical for this market. Comfort with discussing  AI & LLM, Lakehouse, Lakebase, governance  

 Industry POV: A strong point of view on macro trends in high-growth SaaS and key persona triggers, helping to shape our industry advantage against peers. 

 Open Source Knowledge: A strong understanding of the open-source ecosystem and how it integrates with proprietary enterprise platforms. 
 AI Builder Experience: Proven track record of hands-on experience building AI systems (MLOps, GenAI apps, or large-scale predictive models). 
 
 Execution & Analytical Skills 
 
 Full-Funnel Expertise: Deep understanding of sales play mechanics, including lead generation, pipeline progression, and consumption drivers. 

 Scale Orientation: A "multiplier" mindset with a passion for activating large-scale field organizations and cross-pollinating best practices. 
 Entrepreneurial Spirit: A "doer" mindset with the ability to operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and drive results across cross-functional teams. 
 
 Leadership & Scale 
 
 Influence Without Hierarchy: Ability to influence & drive outcomes across senior executives & global teams via influence, clarity & presence versus direct reporting lines. 
 Cross-Functional Orchestration: Skill in collaborating with Product, Engineering, and BD leadership to align product roadmap shifts with commercial requirements specific to high-growth SaaS customers. 
   
 Pay Range Transparency

The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected base salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles.  Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipated utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above.  You bring a strong point of view on the customer journey and you're comfortable with ambiguity. You've done the IC work yourself, including dynamic segmentation and personalized messaging across email, in-product, and web for B2B SaaS/developer audiences, and now you want to multiply that impact through strategy, prioritization, and people. 
 This is a highly visible role. You'll act as a change agent across Product, Analytics, Data Science, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations, and you'll be the person stakeholders come to for a clear read on what's working, what's next, and why. 
 This role can be based anywhere on the East Coast of the United States.

 Own the growth marketing strategy and roadmap, deciding what the team prioritizes and why, based on customer journey analysis and business impact 
 Build and manage the experiment pipeline: intake, prioritization, velocity, and a consistent framework for evaluating and scaling wins 
 Set and enforce the quality bar for campaigns, messaging, and experimentation rigor across the team 
 Coach and develop growth marketers, leveling up their strategic thinking, execution, and craft; player-coach mentality 
 Serve as the primary stakeholder manager of your area for Product, Analytics, Data Science, Customer Success, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations, aligning on roadmap moments and cross-functional dependencies 
 Partner with Product leadership to shape the digital experience strategy for converting, retaining, and growing existing users 
 Review and unblock team members' campaigns and experiments, providing hands-on feedback rather than just sign-off

 We’re looking for someone with 
 
 6+ years of B2B SaaS experience in lifecycle and growth marketing Product-led growth experience desired (bonus points for experience/understanding with agent-led growth!)

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead - Growth & Revenue
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.excerpt:
By the 1970s, the travel industry had quietly figured out something that most businesses hadn't: growth at scale required three different go-to-market motions happening at once. Individual travelers booked directly — they walked in, called up, and bought. Corporate travel programs needed a sales rep to negotiate rates and sign contracts. And then there were travel agents: independent businesses with deep client relationships who effectively decided what their clients bought. The airlines and hotel chains that grew fastest were the ones that recognized all of these distribution motions and invested in each of them in the right ways. Mercury runs the same three motions. Most of our growth is self-serve and product-led: Founders discover us, sign up, and stay. Our fast-growing sales team closes meaningful deals with larger businesses. And our partners — incorporators, accountants, investors, and platforms that already have the trust of the businesses we want to reach — refer customers to us the same way a great travel agent would: because they believe in our product and its value to their clients. We are looking for a go-to-market leader who can make all three of these motions work harder together with a data-driven strategy and consistent positioning across the customer journey. 
 What You'll Do 
 
 Own end-to-end GTM strategy across Mercury's three primary growth motions — product-led, sales-led, and partner-led — including segmentation, messaging, and cross-functional execution. 
 Manage and grow a team of product marketers and partner marketers supporting these motions today. 
 Build and maintain the customer journey, messaging, and infrastructure that works across all three motions: shared value propositions and personas that flex appropriately for self-serve onboarding flows, sales conversations, and partner co-marketing 
 Partner closely with the growth product org on strategy and execution for driving top-of-funnel, conversion, activation, and virality.  
 Partner with sales leadership on messaging and enablement, from battlecards and objection-handling frameworks to segment-specific playbooks 
 Develop Mercury's partner marketing strategy in collaboration with the partnerships team — including co-marketing programs, partner enablement materials, and joint GTM playbooks  
 Lead customer and market research to stay ahead of competitive dynamics, identify growth opportunities across segments, and feed insights into product, pricing, and roadmap decisions 
 Define and track the PMM metrics that matter for growth — from activation to adoption to advocacy — and use them to continuously improve GTM strategy 
 
 You Should Have 
 
 10+ years of B2B product marketing experience, with full ownership of GTM strategy — not just launch coordination 
 Demonstrated experience driving growth across multiple GTM motions; you've run product-led, sales-led, and partner-led programs, and you understand how they interact 
 Strong messaging and positioning craft — you can develop a compelling narrative from scratch, test it with customers, and translate it into assets that actually get used by sales and partners 
 Revenue mindset — you track contribution to pipeline, activation, and retention, and you know how to use data to argue for, refine, and defend your strategy 
 Experience working with sales leadership on messaging and proof points to improve their team’s ability to source pipeline and close deals.  
 Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority — aligning sales, product, partnerships, and growth teams around a shared GTM plan 
 
 Nice to Have 
 
 Fintech, banking*, or financial services experience — familiarity with the regulatory, trust, and competitive dynamics of this space 
 Experience at a company that scaled through multiple GTM channels simultaneously, particularly one with a strong PLG foundation that was extending into enterprise and/or channel 
 Data fluency — comfortable pulling your own analysis in Amplitude, Hex, Metabase, or SQL rather than waiting on a data team 
 
 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Influencer Marketing
jobs.excerpt:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  
 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  
 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. We're looking for a Manager of Influencer Marketing to build and scale the operational backbone of our global influencer program. This is not a traditional campaign role — you'll be the person who turns creator relationships and regional programs into a repeatable, data-driven machine. You'll own the systems, playbooks, and tools that allow our influencer marketing team to operate efficiently at scale across markets and content types. 
 This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and program operations, and is ideal for someone who thinks in systems, loves building things from scratch, and is energized by the challenge of bringing structure to a fast-moving space. 
 You will: 
 Program Operations & Scale 
 
 Design and manage the operational infrastructure for a global influencer program spanning multiple content types, markets, and campaign types 
 Partner with web systems team to manage front-end, creator facing authenticated portal as well as back-end systems 
 Build scalable workflows in our CRM system for influencer sourcing, contracting, onboarding, activation, and reporting — reducing manual lift while increasing output 
 Define and maintain program standards, SLAs, and intake processes across internal stakeholders and external partners 
 Partner with legal, finance, and other internal and external partners to streamline contracting and payment operations globally 
 
 Global Playbooks 
 
 Develop and maintain a suite of global playbooks covering influencer program application management, relationship tiering, campaign briefing, content guidelines, and performance benchmarking 
 Localize frameworks for regional teams while preserving global consistency in brand standards and measurement methodology 
 Establish best practices for new program verticals (e.g., live events, product launches, always-on ambassador programs) and codify learnings into repeatable resources 
 Train and enable cross-functional partners and regional teams on playbook adoption 

 CRM & Tooling 
 
 Lead the buildout of a centralized influencer CRM and creator-facing portal — defining data architecture, contact management standards, tagging taxonomy, and relationship history tracking 
 Build, evaluate, implement, and own influencer marketing technology (CRM platforms, discovery tools, reporting dashboards) and serve as the internal subject matter expert 
 Partner with data and analytics teams to develop dashboards that give real-time visibility into program health, creator performance, and spend efficiency 
 Ensure creator-facing portal is dynamic and up to date with our backend updates, and tooling for influencers adoption and usage. 
 Identify gaps in existing tooling and build or commission solutions that reduce friction and improve team output 

 You have: 
 
 8-10 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or a closely related field, with at least 2 years in a role focused on operations, program management, or marketing technology 
 Exceptional project management skills — highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a rapidly changing environment 
 Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving influencer marketing infrastructure — playbooks, workflows, CRM systems, or reporting tools 
 Comfort operating across global markets and working with regional teams to adapt centralized frameworks 
 Strong analytical skills; able to work fluently with data to drive decisions and communicate program performance to leadership 
 Clear, concise communicator who can translate complex operational concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences 
 A bias toward building: you'd rather create a system than patch a problem 
 Experience in gaming, entertainment, or consumer tech — particularly with creator ecosystems tied to UGC or live platforms 
 Familiarity with influencer contract structures, FTC guidelines, and international compliance considerations 
 Background in or exposure to marketing analytics, business intelligence tools, or data pipeline basics 
 Experience supporting large-scale live events or product launches with influencer programming components

jobs.title: Creative Program Manager - Events, AWS Brand and Creative
jobs.excerpt:
AWS Brand & Creative is on a mission to establish AWS as the world's undisputed leader in AI and technology — shaping how customers, developers, and prospective customers perceive, trust, and choose AWS. We are seeking a Creative Program Manager for Global Events who combines sharp program execution with creative sensibility and a passion for delivering world-class brand experiences at scale. This is not a role for someone content to simply track timelines. This is a role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, drives complex creative workstreams from concept through delivery, and knows what it takes to bring a brand to life in physical and digital environments that shift customer perception. You will own the marketing execution and measurable brand impact of the Kernel brand update across the Global Events portfolio — including re:Invent — defining how the new AWS brand comes to life on-site so it shifts perception of AWS as a leader in AI and technology. The right candidate moves fluidly between strategic planning and hands-on execution. They have the operational rigor to manage complex, multi-workstream event programs and the creative judgment to ensure brand integrity, defend bold experiential ideas, and drive alignment across internal teams and external agency partners at every stage Key job responsibilities Event Brand Activation & Creative Execution • Drive the execution of creative services and translation of the AWS brand for the Global Events portfolio, including re:Invent — encompassing event experience, on-site brand expression, and messaging that ladder to brand foundations • Independently manage end-to-end creative workflows for complex onsite campaigns, toolkits, and playbooks of large-scale initiatives with global impact • Drive consistent adoption of AWS brand guidance among cross-Amazon partners contributing to events, ensuring brand adherence across all event dimensions • Develop and optimize the marketing and creative services approach for event brand moments, auditing effectiveness and surfacing insights that influence broader brand and event strategy Program & Stakeholder Management • Proactively partner with key event stakeholders to define success criteria and measurement approach for event brand activations, connecting initiatives to drive brand perception, awareness, and consideration • Manage campaign alignment meetings and creative reviews with senior stakeholders and partners; provide clear, concise communication (briefs, creative reviews, MBR/QBR, go-to-market plans, post-mortems) • Proactively mitigate risk and manage scope to ensure high-quality, on-time delivery; clear blockers (path to green) and escalate appropriately • Deep dive into project requirements, gaining understanding of needs for projects that may be ambiguous Agency & Vendor Management • Partner with and manage internal creative teams and external agency partners from concept through delivery across multiple digital content types • Manage creative asset production and delivery across digital and brand channels, including localization workflows • For multi-country initiatives, collaborate with partners across locales to share learnings, identify bottlenecks, and support global execution • Lead agency and vendor coordination including scope definition, resourcing, budget/PO management, and performance accountability Operational Excellence & Innovation • Own overarching team workflows and processes in partnership with creative leads, campaign managers, and business partners; continue to define and improve existing processes and utilize tool solutions for better efficiency • Proactively collect and share best practices and playbooks with creatives and campaign teams; build reusable mechanisms (playbooks, briefing/review templates) • Embrace and advance AI adoption — leveraging AI tools and agentic workflows to increase the speed, quality, and scale of the work, and helping the team adopt new ways of working About the team Our mission is to establish and advance AWS as the world's undisputed leader in AI and technology, shaping how customers, developers, and prospective customers perceive, trust, and choose AWS, while empowering the entire AWS Marketing organization to deliver brand-consistent, strategically inventive, and creatively excellent work at scale. We work backwards from our end customers: business decision-makers, developers and builders, and technical leaders who are sophisticated, skeptical of marketing, and increasingly bombarded with AI claims from every direction. 

Basic qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience - Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns - Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams - Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels - Experience across affiliate marketing, PPC, SEM and social media advertising

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process - Experience equally comfortable building strategic marketing plans and executing at a tactical level - Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience using complex financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to inform strategic business decisions and influence cross-functional stakeholders, with proven business impact (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) - Knowledge of Adobe design programs including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign - Experience in multi-territory campaign management - Experience managing large-scale brand activations or events, ideally including tentpole moments such as re:Invent - Track record leading cross-functional creative teams and external agencies from concept through delivery Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, WA, Seattle - 82,700.00 - 137,900.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Field Marketing Manager to own and execute our field marketing strategy. This role blends best-in-class tactical execution with strategic planning and operational rigor. You’ll lead the planning and delivery of first-party and third-party events, regional activations, and integrated campaigns designed to drive pipeline, lead generation, and revenue impact across the US market.

This is an individual contributor role for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and partners closely with GTM. You’ll be expected to build programs and processes from the ground up, continuously iterate and improve how we operate, and roll up your sleeves to execute—from developing the strategy and playbooks to being on the ground making it happen.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the planning and execution of US field marketing programs, including first-party events (executive dinners, roundtables, happy hours, and experiential events) and third-party events (conferences, sponsorships, partner activations).

 - Design and deliver field marketing initiatives that drive measurable pipeline and lead generation, aligned to regional targets, priority accounts, and GTM objectives.

 - Partner closely with the US GTM team to develop territory-based and account-focused event strategies, including pre- and post-event engagement and follow-up.

 - Manage end-to-end event delivery, including budgets, logistics, vendors, agencies, on-site execution, and post-event reporting.

 - Lead the development of scalable field marketing playbooks, processes, and best practices to support growth and consistency globally.

 - Own and manage relationships with external agencies, event partners, and third-party organizers, ensuring high-quality delivery and strong ROI.

 - Track, analyze, and report on the performance of field marketing activities, using data and insights to continuously improve impact and efficiency.

WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 4–7 years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation within B2B SaaS or professional services.

 - Proven ability to deliver high-impact field events and activations that drive measurable pipeline and lead generation.

 - Strong experience partnering with Sales on territory-based or account-focused marketing initiatives.

 - Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills, with a high bar for execution and detail.

 - Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Marketo (or similar), and event platforms is highly desirable.

 - Experience marketing to legal, financial services, consulting, or other high-touch professional audiences is a plus.

COMPENSATION

$ 90,100 - $123,900 USD

jobs.title: Scale Partner Marketing Lead
jobs.location: San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Chicago, Atlanta, Remote in the US
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The Partner Marketing team extends Stripe’s marketing reach to customers and prospects by educating, engaging, and enabling partners, globally, to build market awareness and generate demand for their Stripe solutions and services. We recruit prospective partners and support the on-boarding and growth of existing partners as they build, launch, market, and scale business through the Stripe Partner Ecosystem and the Stripe platform. We partner closely with our global partnerships, GTM, marketing, and product teams and serve many different partner types. 
 What you’ll do 
 We’re looking for an experienced, creative, results-oriented marketer to lead our Global Scale Partner Marketing strategy and team. You will be directly responsible for a global scale marketing team of 6, in addition to 15-20 contracted marketing coordinators with a dotted-line reporting relationship. This role leads defining our scaled operating model and partner marketing investment model across our to, through, and with partner marketing functions. This individual will develop and lead a team that creates the strategy and executes: to partner communications, Stripe-led events & our Partner Advisory Board, online & field events (inclusive of designing and managing a shared resource of marketing coordinators for regional execution), campaign content, Partner program strategy & partner journeys, and market development funds (MDF) & incentive design. 
 We are looking for a candidate that can develop the new operating model, form this new, integrated partner marketing function, and deliver a shared global service across multiple Global Partner Segments. This role will have the opportunity to build out the strategy and scale growth plan for our partner marketing segments globally and locally, innovating marketing approaches to maximize ROI. This team's programs will generate demand, accelerate GTM pipeline, and strengthen partner relationships globally, supporting Stripe’s mission of increasing the GDP of the internet. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Set and communicate a clear vision, strategy, and operating model for the newly created scale partner marketing organization, with functions on the team including:
 
 To-partner communications: Lead the development of to-partner value propositions aligned by partner type, an editorial calendar inclusive of omnichannel tactics and governance process working across partner marketing, sales, product, and marketing. 
 Stripe-led events & Partner Advisory Board: Lead partner strategy for Stripe’s flagship event Sessions, Stripe Tour, tier one industry events and develop and lead a Partner Advisory Board program. 
 Online & field events: Lead the development of a global online and regional event engine to drive consistency & efficiency in execution, inclusive of developing a capacity model and event calendar in partnership with partner marketing segment leaders. 
 Campaign content: Lead the development of Partner co-marketing materials aligned to our Stripe campaign roadmap, determining the prioritization based on to-partner value proposition & opportunity, ensuring content stays updated at all times, and innovating on content based on partner usage data.   
 Partner program strategy & partner journeys: Develop the partner journey by partner type and tier across the partner lifecycle to inform Partner Program requirements, prioritize those requirements, and lead the brand and marketing of the Stripe Partner Ecosystem. 
 MDF & incentive design: Develop, implement and manage a MDF program and incentives that motivates partners to exceed the growth objectives of our product and sales segments. Create a partner benefits program leveraging funds matched by Stripe that allows partners to easily extend Stripe’s distribution through marketing campaigns. 

 Manage, coach, and develop a high-performing team of partner marketers; create an inclusive, accountable team culture and identify opportunities to grow leadership capability across the organization. Build strong senior relationships across Partner Marketing Segment Leads, Campaigns, Regional Marketing, Demand Generation, Field Marketing, Partnerships, and other stakeholder teams; resolve cross-functional tradeoffs, resourcing gaps, and execution blockers 
 Establish rigorous measurement and learning practices for partner marketing, synthesizing performance across marketing engines to identify the levers that most effectively drive customer acquisition, activation, and partner impact—and share those insights broadly 
 
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 15+ years of relevant B2B partner marketing experience 
 5+ years of direct people management experience, including managing managers and building teams of 5+ people 
 Experience working as part of a global marketing team with execution across different regions 
 Proven ability to influence and guide the partner’s marketing leadership team to align on objectives and deliver against joint marketing priorities and plans 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills that demonstrate proven leadership capabilities and ability to collaborate cross-functionally 
 Experience shaping value proposition and messaging framework 
 Demonstrated experience in measuring and improving the ROI of marketing investments through marketing engines 
 Deep understanding of the user journey through and with a partner channel and funnel, sales cycle and product lifecycle and their respective requirements on the partner marketing organization to drive attach, growth and revenue  
 Superb organization and project management skills and the capacity to manage multiple complex projects at once 
 Experience in managing distributed teams across different timezones 
 Excellent analytical skills and the ability to craft actionable insights from complex data 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Experience in the payments, financial technology, or adjacent industries or marketing FinTech solutions  
 Experience at a highly dynamic, high-growth tech company 
 Experience with demand generation marketing or product marketing
