jobs.excerpt:
About the Team

OpenAI is building the next generation of advertising for an AI-powered world. As AI changes how people discover information, explore possibilities, and make decisions, we believe this presents a huge opportunity for small and medium-sized businesses to connect with customers in new ways.

The SMB Ads Marketing team is building this opportunity from the ground up. We define how businesses discover OpenAI’s advertising platform, become successful advertisers, and grow their investment over time. Working closely with Product, Ads Engineering, Data Science, and Sales, we combine customer insight, rigorous experimentation, and fast execution to turn early opportunities into scalable growth.

About the Role

We are seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to build, own, and lead lifecycle programs for SMB advertisers at OpenAI. This is a zero-to-one opportunity to establish the strategy and programs that guide businesses from initial interest and their first campaign to sustained success and growth.

You will set the lifecycle strategy, own the program roadmap and performance goals, and lead delivery from customer insight and journey design through launch, measurement, and iteration. Combining behavioral insights, experimentation, and personalized engagement across email, product experiences, education, and other channels, you will build programs that scale with the business. Success requires independent judgment, analytical depth, cross-functional leadership, and hands-on execution.

In This Role, You Will

 - Own the lifecycle program portfolio across prospect conversion, activation, retention, repeat spend, reactivation, and expansion.

 - Map advertiser journeys using cohort analysis, product behavior, campaign performance, and customer feedback to identify high-impact growth opportunities.

 - Build segmented, triggered journeys that connect advertiser needs, intent, readiness, and behavior to relevant messages and next steps.

 - Lead prospect nurture and email acquisition programs. Coordinate audiences, retargeting, and conversion experiences with Growth Marketing.

 - Launch onboarding and education programs that help advertisers create campaigns, understand performance, adopt capabilities, and grow their investment.

 - Coordinate delivery across email, in-product and onsite experiences, retargeting, education, and sales engagement with channel and product teams.

 - Test audiences, messaging, channels, timing, frequency, and offers. Use holdouts and downstream results to measure incremental customer impact.

 - Define data signals, segmentation, instrumentation, automation, and measurement with Data Science, Marketing Operations, prospect intelligence teams, and Ads Engineering.

 - Maintain high standards for journey quality, contact frequency, suppression, consent, and deliverability with operations and privacy partners.

 - Improve activation, time to first campaign, retention, repeat spend, reactivation, and expansion. Scale effective programs and use AI to accelerate content, personalization, and analysis.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

 - Demonstrate a track record of building and leading lifecycle programs from strategy through execution, with measurable activation, retention, or customer-growth results.

 - Translate customer behavior into effective engagement strategies through customer empathy, clear communication, and disciplined prioritization.

 - Build behavioral segmentation and triggered programs using product and customer signals across multiple channels.

 - Apply cohort analysis, funnel diagnostics, retention measurement, and experimental design to distinguish engagement from incremental customer outcomes.

 - Bring hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms, such as Marketo or comparable tools, including journey logic, personalization, and quality assurance.

 - Lead cross-functional programs with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, and Marketing Operations, aligning priorities and driving delivery.

 - Set strategy and launch programs in fast-moving environments while establishing repeatable processes and reliable measurement.

 - Bring experience with SMBs, self-serve products, advertising, SaaS, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-volume customer journeys. Use AI thoughtfully to improve personalization and execution.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building lifecycle programs for SMB advertisers or self-serve advertising platforms.

 - Track record launching onboarding and education programs that accelerate first campaign creation and repeat spend.

 - Experience connecting email, in-product messaging, retargeting, and sales engagement into coordinated customer journeys.

 - Experience using holdout tests and cohort analysis to measure incremental retention and revenue impact.

 - Hands-on experience establishing behavioral triggers, automation, and measurement for new lifecycle programs.

 - Experience applying AI to improve personalization, content development, and campaign analysis.

jobs.excerpt:
Join us in building the future of finance. 
 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role 
 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 
 The Business Analyst team shapes the strategy, growth, and performance of Robinhood's credit products, delivering top-tier experiences for our users. As part of the broader Credit organization, we work closely with product, engineering, risk, and operations to unlock sustainable business growth through deep analytical rigor. Our team fosters a collaborative, ownership-driven culture where every analyst directly influences business strategy and product direction. 
 As a Business Analyst, you'll be part of an 18-month rotational program, completing approximately five rotations across different areas of our Money and Growth org. Each rotation embeds you alongside product, engineering, risk, and operations teams — giving you direct exposure to the metrics, stakeholders, and strategic priorities that drive Robinhood's core business. You'll own real work from day one, build cross-functional fluency fast, and leave each rotation having made a measurable impact. 
 This role is based in our Washington, D.C. office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. 
 At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Build fluency across the Money and Growth org by rotating through roughly 5 distinct team assignments over the program, each with its own stakeholders, metrics, and strategic priorities 
 Analyze business performance metrics and economic drivers to identify growth opportunities and optimize business outcomes 
 Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems across product strategy, pricing, user segmentation, and risk-return trade-offs 
 Partner with engineering, product, risk, and finance teams to execute key strategic initiatives and monitor program efficacy 
 Develop analytical models, dashboards, and executive-level presentations to inform leadership decision-making and influence core business direction 
 
 What you bring 
 
 Experience in business analysis, strategy, management consulting, financial services, or a quantitative analytical role 
 Strong proficiency in SQL and advanced quantitative modeling techniques 
 Ability to synthesize complex quantitative findings into clear, actionable recommendations for cross-functional partners 
 Fluency with AI tools, with a genuine interest in staying current as the tools evolve 
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience 
 
 What we offer 
 
 Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career 
 Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching 
 Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents 
 Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not  
 Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more 
 Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits 
 Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! 
 Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces 
 In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. 
 Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. 
 Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $110,000 — $110,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. 
 If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. 
 Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Knowledge Work - Core Products
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 There are close to a billion knowledge workers in the world, and only a small fraction of them have discovered what it feels like to work alongside AI that actually raises their game. Most people who could benefit from an AI collaborator haven't tried one yet, or tried once and didn't see what was possible. Closing that gap isn't a copywriting problem — it's a storytelling and enablement problem at a scale few companies have ever had to solve. That's what this role owns. 
 We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the foundational positioning and story for Claude's core knowledge-work products — Chat, Cowork, and the broader non-coding suite. Everything that helps a knowledge worker understand what's possible, and a buyer decide with confidence, runs through your work: the website, the pitch decks, the battlecards, the persona narratives. You're not just making the case that people should adopt AI — you're equipping the people who decide to buy it and showing the people who use it, at the scale of millions, exactly how to put it to work. 
 This is an individual-contributor role built for someone who wants to do deep, durable craft work on products with enormous, established usage. You'll write the positioning doc, build the battlecards, and ship the persona work yourself, and you'll use Claude and AI-native workflows to keep those foundations self-updating and trusted by every team that depends on them. 
 If you've owned the full product marketing stack for a large, widely-used, fast-evolving product, have building instincts for turning your own PMM workflows into systems rather than one-off documents, and want your writing to be the reason millions of people and the buyers who equip them finally understand what an AI collaborator can do, this role is for you. 
 Responsibilities 

 Define the story that gets millions of people to change how they work. Own and evolve the positioning and messaging house for Chat, Cowork, and Claude's core knowledge-work products, so every deck, campaign, and piece of content makes the same compelling case for what's possible. 

 Give sellers the conviction to close. Build and maintain the sales enablement assets — pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling — that turn a good product into deals won, arming GTM to sell with confidence rather than guesswork. 

 Equip buyers to make the call with confidence. Own the proof points, comparisons, and narratives that help economic buyers and champions justify the purchase and adoption decision internally, not just the end users who'll use the product day to day. 

 Make sure the message lands with the right person, in their language. Develop ICP and persona frameworks that translate a broad, varied base of knowledge workers and buyers into insights sharp enough to drive messaging and campaigns that actually resonate. 

 Make our inspiring story come to life. Own the website and product page messaging that's often someone's very first encounter with what Claude can do for their work — the moment that decides whether they lean in or bounce. 

 Turn scattered wins into a playbook others can run. Build libraries of top use cases by product and by function or persona, so the best examples of AI-augmented work aren't one-off stories, they're patterns anyone can copy. 

 Keep every team telling the same story, well. Partner closely with GTM, Marketing, and Partners so they're never working from stale or inconsistent materials. 

 "Claudify" our own foundations. Build AI-native systems, using Claude and beyond-chat workflows like Skills and automations, that keep positioning, messaging, personas, and enablement current and instantly trustworthy — proof, in how you work, of the same transformation you're asking millions of others to make. 

 Contribute to how we present plans, pricing, and analyst relations materials for the core knowledge-work portfolio as they intersect with your positioning and messaging work 

 You may be a good fit if you 

 Have proven experience owning positioning and messaging for an established software product used broadly across personas and use cases 

 Have strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt tone and complexity across formats — pitch decks, web copy, battlecards, persona docs 

 Have experience building ICP and persona frameworks and translating research into messaging that scales across websites, collateral, campaigns, and content 

 Have experience building sales enablement assets and working directly with sales teams on objection handling and win/loss dynamics 

 Are comfortable operating autonomously as an IC, writing and shipping assets directly rather than through a team 

 Demonstrate systems thinking, and the ability to move fast and with conviction in an always-evolving environment 

 Are well-versed in using AI — namely Claude — to inform and automate product marketing workflows, and have built foundational systems that inform, update, and share PMM foundations with the stakeholders who depend on them 

 Have experience marketing AI or productivity software to a broad, cross-functional buyer base 

 Strong candidates may also have 

 Experience with analyst relations processes and reports (e.g., Gartner, Forrester) 

 Familiarity with plans and pricing presentation and packaging communication 

 Experience as a Senior PMM or PMM Lead at a productivity, collaboration, or knowledge-work software company with ownership of core-product positioning 

 Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect staff to be able to work from our San Francisco or New York office at least once a month for cross-functional stakeholder engagement. Additionally, this role will require up to 40% travel for events and customer engagements. 
 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspe

jobs.title: AWS Marketing Cross Channel Mgr, AWS Marketing Demand Center
jobs.excerpt:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Cross Channel Operations Manager to join the Integrated Demand Center (IDC) Channels team. This role serves as the operational backbone of the Channels organization, ensuring seamless execution across all digital marketing channels and enabling the team to deliver high-impact demand generation programs at scale. Reporting into the Channels leadership team, you will partner closely with the Cross Channel Strategy Lead and channel managers to drive operational excellence across campaign performance, budget management, process documentation, creative operations, and vendor management. You will own the operational rhythm of the business, including staff meeting governance, campaign status tracking, SOP development, and knowledge management. This role is critical to maintaining velocity and quality as the Channels team scales its impact across AWS Marketing. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in fast-paced environments, brings strong organizational skills, and has a passion for streamlining processes and mechanisms that make teams more effective. Key job responsibilities Operational Leadership & Program Management • Meeting Governance: Own and manage cross channels meeting agendas, sourcing and prioritizing the right topics (e.g., strategic initiatives, learnings from new areas, tiger team updates) and that meetings drive decisions and accountability. • Operational Rhythm: Establish and maintain the operational cadence for the Channels team, including weekly syncs, monthly business reviews, quarterly planning cycles, and cross-functional alignment meetings. • Project Coordination: Track and drive progress on cross-channel initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and clear ownership across workstreams. Campaign Operations & Tracking • Demand Plan Status Management: Maintain visibility into the status of all demand plans, AWS Summits, re:Invent, and other priority programs with a specific eye for common or consistent issues across multiple aspects of the team. Develop plans to mitigate common issues and provide regular status updates to leadership. • Cross-Channel Coordination: Coordinate across channel teams (SEM, SEO, social, email, programmatic, web, and organic search) to ensure milestones are met and dependencies are managed. • Performance Reporting Support: Partner with Demand Services and analytics teams to compile performance data, support reporting, and draw insights for leadership reviews. Budget & Resource Management • Budget Management: Support the Channels budget process, manage finance mechanisms including monthly finance reviews in coordination with the AWS finance team counterparts to track spend against plan, bring insights, and flag variances to leadership. • Finance Tooling: Coordinate with AWS finance to streamline existing budget tooling processes and ways to automate submittals and approvals (e.g. AMPs tooling). Documentation & Knowledge Management • SOP Documentation: Develop, maintain, and evangelize Standard Operating Procedures for key Channels workflows. Ensure SOPs are accessible, current, and adopted by the team. • Wiki Governance: Own the Channels wiki and internal knowledge base. Establish a governance model for content updates and actively deprecate outdated documentation to maintain a single source of truth. • Onboarding Materials: Create and maintain onboarding guides for new team members and contractors, accelerating ramp time and ensuring consistency. • Best Practices and Channel Guides: Develop, maintain, and implement integration of channels guidance and best practices into broader IDC team processes. For example, integrate channel content best practices into content creation frameworks within the content studio team. Cross Channel Customer Journeys • Channel orchestrator: Represent Channels requirements, risk/opportunity considerations, and ensure channel-specific impacts are surfaced early in journey activation decisions. Participate in CX journey planning and AEP orchestration discussions. Maintain a regular communication mechanism with the Digital Strategy team and serve as the primary coordination point between CX and all Channels sub-teams (Email, Paid Media, Organic, Web, Search). Vendor & Contractor Management • Vendor Transitions: Plan and execute vendor and contractor transitions (e.g., optimus, help desk, agency support), including developing transition plans, managing timelines, and ensuring continuity of service. • Contractor Oversight: Coordinate with external contractors and agency partners, ensuring deliverables meet quality standards and SLAs. About the team The Marketing Channels team resides within the Integrated Demand Center (IDC). The IDC is responsible for designing and delivering globally scalable demand campaigns that reflect AWS's top business priorities. The Demand Center sets campaign strategy, develops and localizes core content, executes across owned and paid media channels, manages the customer journey, and tracks performance through an analytics and measurement function. The Channels team activates campaigns across digital platforms using a mix of in-house content and external agency support. Channels is accountable for defining channel strategy, building and launching channel-specific tactics, and optimizing performance in partnership with Demand Services. AWS Marketing leads the charge in cloud innovation, inspiring and empowering customers and partners to unlock their cloud potential. We shape AWS's industry perception through compelling narratives that demonstrate our leadership in AI and transformative solutions, while driving customer growth across our vast service portfolio. Join our forward-thinking team to shape the future of cloud computing in an inclusive, collaborative environment where diverse perspectives and bold thinking thrive. 

Basic qualifications:
- 6+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience - Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements - Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs - Experience communicating results to senior leadership - Experience utilizing generative AI tools (e.g. Quick, Claude) to conduct deep analytical research, create data tables, and exec level reporting with insights.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience creating and executing integrated marketing lead generation campaigns using tactics that include live or virtual events, webinars, email, lead nurture programs, and CRM/sales insights - Experience with Salesforce and Tableau Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, WA, Seattle - 125,400.00 - 169,600.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Seattle, WA
jobs.excerpt:
The Company You’ll Join 
 Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work. 
 For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page . The Problems You'll Solve 
 At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As Performance Marketing Manager you’ll work to:  
 
 Deploy Winning Strategies for Paid Media Across All Segments. Evaluate and implement diversified multi-channel, full funnel media plans that create demand with buyers across all segments and business units – from SMB to Mid Market and Enterprise. 
 Drive Channel Efficiency. Expand our global digital footprint and generate high-quality sales opportunities that support our ambitious growth targets. Identify and evaluate the effectiveness of our channels across paid search, digital ads and third party media and review sites. Improve return on ad spend and optimize channels through a pragmatic test and scale approach. 
 Support Campaign Execution Excellence: Design, manage, and optimize paid activities for marketing campaigns to meet direct response, demand generation, and awareness objectives.Work closely with campaign managers, content, product marketing, sales, and operations  to align messaging, optimize lead handoff, and drive full-funnel success. 
 Embrace Innovation and Experimentation. Be on the forefront of paid advertising and demand generation trends and tools, deploying high-potential pilots and scaling the most promising outcomes. Conduct rigorous A/B testing on ad creatives, landing pages, and targeting to continuously improve campaign effectiveness and efficiency. 
 Grow and Improve Paid Media Results through ABM and Personalization. Develop campaign executions which support ABM and Demand at Scale, including new full-funnel personalization strategies through the deployment of innovative creative and ad formats.Collaborate with web, organic search and organic social stakeholders to extend learnings across teams. 
 
 The Performance Marketing Manager  plays a critical role in setting and executing paid media strategy to deliver on pipeline targets across all of Carta’s business units. This role is an essential partner for Campaign Management, Web, Content, Customer Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Business Operations both in the US and in EMEA/AMEA regions.  
 The Team You'll Work With 
 You’ll be joining our Performance Marketing Team reporting to our Performance Marketing Lead. The Performance Marketing team is responsible for driving meaningful and high quality lead volume and pipeline growth. We are flexible, data-driven, and equally focused on scale and efficiency. Our team is made up of collaborative, strategic thought partners focused on problem solving. 
 About You 
 
 A strategic and analytical thinker who can distill complex marketing concepts and performance insights for an executive audience  
 6+ years of experience  in demand generation and/or performance marketing with at least 3 years experience in B2B   
 Fluent in Ad platforms and networks (e.g. Google Ads, Google Display Network, GA4, LinkedIn, Reddit, OpenAI) 
 Familiar with Marketing Automation and Attribution tools (Marketo Measure, Dreamdata, Salesforce) 
 Experience using data visualization tools to craft narratives (e.g. Looker, Tableau, etc) 
 Fluent  in  Personalization, ABM Platforms and DSPs (e.g. 6Sense, Contentful, Qualified, etc) 
 BA required 
 SaaS experience across SMB, Mid-Market and Enterprise segments strongly preferred 
 Understanding of the latest in marketing mix modeling and predictive analytics preferred 
 
 Salary 
 Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:  
 
 $127,500 - $150,000  in San Francisco, CA and New York, NY  
 $121,125 - $142,500 in Seattle, WA  
 
 Final offers may vary from the amount listed based on geography, candidate experience and expertise, and other factors. 
   
   Disclosures: 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.  
 Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details. 
 For information on our data privacy policies, see  Privacy ,  CA Candidate Privacy , and Brazil Transparency Report . 
 Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com or @carta-external.com domain. Report any contact from unapproved domains to security@carta.com.

jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 What you’ll do 
 We are seeking an organized, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative Executive Engagement Marketing Manager for the Americas to lead the operational execution of executive engagement and hospitality programs across the region. This role will translate program strategy into excellent execution by building the systems, communications, tools, tracking, and cross-functional coordination needed to deliver high-touch experiences for senior external audiences. 
 You will work closely with Sales to identify and engage executives from targeted accounts, enable sellers with clear outreach materials and follow-up workflows, and ensure each program has the right operational foundation before, during, and after the event. The successful candidate is comfortable independently managing multiple complex workstreams, navigating ambiguity, and proactively improving how programs operate at scale. 
 Responsibilities 
 Operations and Program Delivery 

 Independently manage the operational planning and execution of a portfolio of executive engagement and hospitality programs across the Americas, including executive dinners, hosted experiences, and sports hospitality programs 
 Build and maintain detailed program plans, timelines, workback schedules, attendee management processes, event briefs, and cross-functional communication plans 
 Partner with the Global Experiential Lead and internal stakeholders to translate program objectives, target audiences, and event formats into clear execution plans 

 Sales Enablement and Audience Engagement 

 Partner closely with Sales and account teams to support the identification, prioritization, and outreach of senior executives at targeted accounts 
 Develop and manage seller enablement materials, including invitations, outreach templates, event details, attendee lists, follow-up guidance, and account-specific communications 
 Coordinate the end-to-end attendee journey—from invitation strategy and outreach through registration, confirmations, event-day communications, and post-event follow-up 

 Marketing Operations and Measurement 

 Own the event marketing bill of materials, including email journeys, registration or landing pages, attendee communications, and supporting campaign assets 
 Partner with Marketing Operations to execute campaigns and workflows that support invitations, registration, attendance, and post-event follow-up 
 Partner with Analytics and Program Management to establish consistent tracking, reporting, and measurement for executive engagement programs, aligned with broader marketing standards 

 Event Execution and Hospitality 

 Coordinate operational details across internal teams, agencies, venues, and other partners to ensure programs are delivered reliably and meet Stripe's brand and hospitality standards 
 Ensure every event delivers a premium, on-brand Stripe experience appropriate for C-suite and senior executive audiences 
 Support on-site event execution as needed 

 Cross-Functional Collaboration 

 Build productive working relationships across Experiential, Sales, Regional Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, Analytics, Program Management, and external partners, creating clarity around roles, decisions, dependencies, and next steps 
 Communicate proactively and clearly, particularly when tradeoffs, risks, or changes could affect program delivery or the attendee experience 

 Continuous Improvement and Shared Learning 

 Identify risks, dependencies, and execution gaps early; recommend practical solutions and escalate when broader program decisions are needed 
 Capture learnings and maintain repeatable playbooks, templates, and operating practices that improve future program delivery 
 Use program data, stakeholder feedback, and operational observations to identify opportunities to improve audience targeting, communications, follow-up, and program execution 

 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 4+ years of experience in event marketing, field marketing, marketing operations, executive programs, hospitality, or a related B2B marketing role 
 Experience managing complex, detail-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders, deadlines, and dependencies 
 Demonstrated ability to operate independently within a defined area of responsibility, prioritize competing workstreams, and make sound decisions with incomplete information 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to communicate effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external executive audiences 
 Strong project management skills, including experience developing workback plans, coordinating deliverables, tracking progress, and resolving execution issues 
 Strong operational and analytical mindset, with experience using program data, stakeholder feedback, and reporting to improve execution 
 Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Experience supporting executive engagement programs, C-suite events, customer hospitality, hosted dinners, or premium event experiences 
 Experience working in B2B technology, fintech, enterprise marketing, or a similarly complex go-to-market environment 
 Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, event management, and project management tools, such as Salesforce, Splash, Cvent, Asana, or similar platforms 
 Experience building scalable marketing processes, playbooks, templates, or reporting frameworks 
 Experience with event attribution, pipeline workflows, account-based marketing, or executive audience engagement strategies

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

Ramp is looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition on YouTube, ChatGPT, X, Rideshare, and Reddit, and to find new incremental channels. You'll take early experiments and turn them into measurable programs and build the operating model that makes successful channels part of Ramp's evergreen performance marketing mix.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will evaluate channel opportunities, design tests, launch campaigns, and analyze full-funnel performance. You'll work with Growth, Creative, Data, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for measurement & efficiency.

You’ll use AI as a practical part of the job: building systems that speed up research, campaign creation, performance analysis, and day-to-day channel operations.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own performance on YouTube, ChatGPT, X, Rideshare, and Reddit. Understand how conversion events, value signals, and lookalike audiences work at a technical level and use that to make channels more efficient over time.

 - Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new performance marketing channels and acquisition opportunities.

 - Build the path from experiment to evergreen program: prove incremental SQLs and pipeline impact, hit LTV-to-CAC efficiency targets, and document a repeatable operating playbook.

 - Own channels as they mature. Decide when a program stays with you and when it transitions to a dedicated owner so you can keep finding new ones.

 - Analyze performance across the full funnel. Turn incomplete or noisy data into a clear call on what to scale, improve, pause, or stop.

 - Partner with data and engineering to improve tracking, attribution, and reporting, and with Creative on messaging, format, and ad concepts across surfaces, audiences, and channels.

 - Build AI agents, workflows, and tools that help the team test more ideas and operationalize channels faster.

WHAT YOU NEED

 - 3+ years in a performance / quantitative marketing, growth, or comparable decision-science role, where you’ve owned numbers and shaped meaningful outcomes.

 - Strong analytical judgment. You can define success metrics, diagnose and isolate performance issues, and make decisions with imperfect information.

 - You enjoy designing experiments and translating results into a clear call on what to fund, scale, or kill.

 - You've built AI workflows, automations, or agents to improve marketing execution and you have good judgment about where AI accelerates the work and where human review is necessary.

 - You move projects from ambiguity to a clear outcome with limited direction and you're detail-oriented in campaign setup, tracking, and measurement.

NICE-TO-HAVES

 - B2B experience.

 - Experience bringing an experimental channel into a scaled program.

 - Familiarity with attribution, incrementality testing, randomized controlled tests (RCTs), MMM, and marketing measurement.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice https://ramp.com/legal/applicant-privacy-notice

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
About Betterment 
 Betterment  is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.  We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays). 
 About the role 
 We're hiring ambitious, tech-savvy Business Development Representatives to join one of three teams driving top-of-funnel growth across Betterment's retirement and advisor solutions businesses: 
 
 Direct 401(k) BDR — builds pipeline with small and mid-sized businesses looking to launch or switch their 401(k) plan. 
 Advised 401(k) BDR — builds pipeline with financial advisors and RIAs looking to offer or improve 401(k) plans for their business-owner clients. 
 Custody BDR — builds pipeline with independent RIAs evaluating or switching custodians for Betterment Advisor Solutions (BAS). 
 
 In each of these roles, you'll own outbound prospecting at the top of the sales funnel — an activity-heavy role where you'll identify, engage, and qualify prospects before handing off warm opportunities to Account Executives. You're a self-starter who's comfortable with high call/email volume, quick to learn a technical product, and motivated by hitting (and beating) targets. 
 Candidates will be considered for the team(s) whose current hiring needs best match their background and interests; the specific team will be confirmed during the interview process. 
 This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.  
 
 New York City: $60,000-$65,000 
 
 This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of commission. 
 A day in the life 
 Core Responsibilities (All Teams) 
 
 Generate new opportunities using outbound tactics (email sequences, cold calling, LinkedIn, etc) to assist the sales process at the top of the funnel. 
 Identifying, targeting and nurturing potential outbound opportunities by creating new target lists and always being one step ahead of trends. 
 Understanding the need of prospects and communicating them clearly to Account Executives. 
 Clearly articulating Betterment’s Advised value proposition and products to prospects in specific verticals. 
 Meet and exceed meeting set and pipeline goals. 
 Ensure effective and consistent use of Salesforce & other prospecting tools. 
 Provide “voice of the prospect and industry” to marketing and product management to drive roadmaps. 
 We are a close knit team - we work hard, collaborate to get things done and celebrate our wins! 
 
 Direct 401(k) BDR 
 
 Prospect small and mid-sized businesses that are launching a first-time 401(k) plan or looking to switch providers. 
 Engage business owners, HR leaders, and finance decision-makers directly (no advisor intermediary). 
 Position Betterment's 401(k) offering as part of a company's employee benefits strategy. 
 
 Advised 401(k) BDR 
 
 Prospect financial advisors and RIAs who want to add or improve a 401(k) offering for their business-owner clients. 
 Work with decision-makers evaluating whether to add a retirement offering to their practice or transition existing retirement plan business to Betterment. 
 Articulate Betterment Advisor Solutions' value proposition to advisors serving the retirement plan vertical. 
 
 Custody BDR 
 
 Prospect independent RIAs evaluating or switching custodians. 
 Understand and speak to the needs of RIAs regarding custody, technology, and platform support. 
 Position Betterment Advisor Solutions (BAS) as a modern alternative for RIAs re-platforming their custody relationship. 
 
 What we’re looking for 
 
 No experience necessary, however recent sales (or sales adjacent) experience is a plus (i.e. recruiting, real estate, or non-profit experience). 
 B2B tech/SaaS sales experience as an SDR/BDR is a plus. 
 Curiosity and interest for financial products and retirement planning. 
 Demonstrated track record of high performance. 
 High energy and willingness to learn. 
 Strong oral and written communication skills with even stronger listening skills. 
 Relentless in your pursuit of success and are willing to put in the extra effort to achieve your goals. 
 Experience with sales & marketing technology stack. 
 Join a team built on these core values 
 We change lives 
 Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease . 
 We set audacious goals 
 We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins. 
 We value all perspectives 
 When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community. 
 We simplify financial services 
 We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA. 
   Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being: 
 
 We offer a competitive suite of benefits , including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options 
 Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants. 
 Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year. 
 Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees. 
 Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments. 
 
 What happens next 
 We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues. 
 In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions. 
 On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of  applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process.  
 We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process! 
 Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.  
 Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

 Elastic is expanding its Sales Development team to support the explosive adoption of our offerings. Companies like Netflix, Lyft, Facebook, The New York Times, and Tinder (yeah, that Tinder) are looking to Elastic to help solve their big data problems. As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will play a critical role in the success of our sales organization by proactively identifying, nurturing, and creating new opportunities. Unlike most Sales Development organizations, we care about the quality of the interactions you have with our users more than the quantity of calls you make in a day. At Elastic, you will work with current users to understand their use case and help them navigate their Elastic journey. We provide office space for in-person trainings, collaboration, and team building which is used by SDRs on average of 1-2 days per week depending on tenure, team, and preference. The in-person collaboration helps our SDRs to build stronger relationships and develop in a more collaborative and supportive environment. 
 What You Will Be Doing: 
 
 Collaborate with sales, marketing and our partner team to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business 
 Balance the reactive work of responding to interested users with a creative and proactive approach to identify new opportunities 
 Use Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging 
 Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition with a technical audience. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help 
 
 What You Bring: 
 
 0-1 years of SaaS sales experience/ Public Sector or Fed focused preferred 
 Willing to be in the Arlington, VA office 3 days a week. 
 Open to feedback, genuinely curious and constantly looking for ways to learn and improve 
 Genuine love of technology, with the ability to learn and communicate complex technical concepts - Don’t worry, we’ll give you a lot of resources! 
 Not afraid to pick up the phone - this is the path to success! 
 Hitting your monthly targets by being results oriented and focussed on achieving, through self discipline, creativity and passion 
 Wanting to be a part of something bigger than yourself 
 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary plus a variable component, that together comprise the On-Target Earnings (OTE).  On-Target Earnings (OTE) are based on a 70/30 pay mix (base salary / target variable).

 An employee's position within the OTE range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. 
 Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.  As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do. 
 We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do. 
 
 Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary 
 Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

 Generous number of vacation days each year

Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. 
 Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.   
 About the role: 
 
 As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will be responsible for building pipeline through outbound prospecting and inbound qualification. You will help generate qualified leads that result in new business, supporting our scaling efforts and contributing to the success of our team. We are looking for driven professionals with sound business acumen, strong technical aptitude and natural sales instincts to join our fast growing sales organization. This role is based in  New York City and requires in-office presence 2 days per week (Mondays & Wednesdays) . This is a non-negotiable part of the role. 
 
 Responsibilities:   
 
 Grow Cresta’s customer list through personalized emails, calls, and creative social media outreach 
 Write effective and compelling messaging to engage targeted accounts 
 Work closely with Sales and Marketing to plan, strategize, and execute outreach campaigns that help drive revenue growth 
 Analyze market research data and develop strategic approaches to raise awareness and generate interest for Cresta 
 Partner with account executives to help generate meetings and sales pipeline 
 Create and prioritize target account and contact lists 
 Conduct high level conversations with executives in prospect accounts 
 Achieve monthly quotas of meetings, qualified opportunities, and pipeline generated. 
 Assist with drafting sales pitches, presentations, reference material, and other documents as required 
 
 Qualifications We Value: 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field 
 1+ years prior sales experience (within a Software/High Tech company highly preferred) 
 Ability to work in a time-sensitive and high-volume environment 
 Highly competitive personality 
 A positive attitude: You’re a team player and you’re resilient in the face of challenges 
 Self-starter always looking for ways to do your job better. When you see an opportunity, you jump on it 
 Strong organizational skills with ability to effectively prioritize 
 Articulate with strong business acumen 
 You’re a clear, concise, and compelling storyteller across written, verbal, and visual 
 
 Perks & Benefits:

 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family 
 Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it

 In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, San Francisco
jobs.excerpt:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.  
 Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. 
 Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.   
 About the role: 

 This role is based in  San Francisco and requires in-office presence  2 days per week (Mondays & Wednesdays) . This is a non-negotiable part of the role. 

 Address: 332 Pine floor 6 San Francisco, 94104 

 As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will be responsible for building pipeline through outbound prospecting and inbound qualification. You will help generate qualified leads that result in new business, supporting our scaling efforts and contributing to the success of our team. We are looking for driven professionals with sound business acumen, strong technical aptitude and natural sales instincts to join our fast growing sales organization. 
 
 Responsibilities:   
 
 Grow Cresta’s customer list through personalized emails, calls, and creative social media outreach 
 Write effective and compelling messaging to engage targeted accounts 
 Work closely with Sales and Marketing to plan, strategize, and execute outreach campaigns that help drive revenue growth 
 Analyze market research data and develop strategic approaches to raise awareness and generate interest for Cresta 
 Partner with account executives to help generate meetings and sales pipeline 
 Create and prioritize target account and contact lists 
 Conduct high level conversations with executives in prospect accounts 
 Achieve monthly quotas of meetings, qualified opportunities, and pipeline generated. 
 Assist with drafting sales pitches, presentations, reference material, and other documents as required 
 
 Qualifications We Value: 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field 
 1+ years prior sales experience (within a Software/High Tech company highly preferred) 
 Ability to work in a time-sensitive and high-volume environment 
 Highly competitive personality 
 A positive attitude: You’re a team player and you’re resilient in the face of challenges 
 Self-starter always looking for ways to do your job better. When you see an opportunity, you jump on it 
 Strong organizational skills with ability to effectively prioritize 
 Articulate with strong business acumen 
 You’re a clear, concise, and compelling storyteller across written, verbal, and visual 
 
 Perks & Benefits:  
 We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: 
 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family 
 Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it 
 Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child 
 Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future 
 Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office 
 Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced 
 In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees 
 
 Compensation:  
 The on-target earnings (OTE) range for this role is $96,000.00–$125,000.00, depending on level and performance. 
 All hires start as SDR Level 1, with a starting OTE of $96,000.00. Progression through our four-level SDR career path is based on performance, with compensation increasing at each level. High performers can reach the top of the range within ~18 months through promotion. 
 This role includes variable compensation with accelerators, creating upside above OTE. Total compensation also includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package. 
   Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email). Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed. Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta .ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.location: København, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.excerpt:
About Flexport:  
 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.  
 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. The opportunity: 
 Flexport is a freight forwarder and logistics platform using modern software to make global trade easier for everyone. We are solving complex problems on a global scale, and disrupting a multi-trillion dollar industry that has remained stubbornly unchanged. With 40+ offices and warehouses globally, we help the world's fastest growing brands manage their international supply chains, providing a fully-managed service for moving goods between any two places on the planet. 
 Due to our exciting growth here in Europe we are now looking to grow our Sales team and are seeking innovative individuals who can help take us on our journey to the next level.  
 What being an SDR at Flexport does for your career? 
 At Flexport we provide a clear career path for our SDRs: you'll level up your tech sales skills with daily coaching from the best in the business. We don't just hire SDRs, we fast-track you into your next role in a sustainable way, through hands-on, world-class internal training, whether that's Account Executive or Account Manager. 
 You will:  
 Based in our dynamic office in Copenhagen, you will join our growing team of Sales Representatives that are playing a crucial role in Flexport European growth plans. Strategically and with a lot of creativity you will be tasked to getting in touch with good fit companies that want to engage in a conversation with Flexport. 
 No two days will be the same in this challenging role where you will be responsible for: 
 
 Identify and create new sales opportunities for Flexport Europe; 
 Working with Account Executives all over Europe to identify and prioritize strategic opportunities; 
 Demonstrating the value of our offering through phone calls, email, and other social mediums; 
 
 This role will give you the opportunity to learn how global trade works from the ground up and build the foundation for your career in tech sales. Shadowing Account Executives in meetings and other activities to help you acquire the skills you’ll need for your next role on the Flexport sales team. This is an excellent opportunity to join a dynamic team in a business that is going to coach and develop you. We view our sales development teams as the talent engine for the rest of the sales organisation. Meaning: we give you the tools to be empowered and really take your sales and consultative skills to the next level. 
 You’ll be joining a sales team with a lot of emphasis, combining great culture, a place to succeed and focus on career development make this a fun & dynamic place to work. 
 You should have: 
 We are looking for high energy people who want to learn and develop their sales skills. Who are enthusiastic communicators, love being on the phone and adding value to customers, able to empathise and present solutions to suit their needs. This role would suit someone who had a bachelor degree or higher and is commercially minded, with some sales or commercial experience in their pocket. Above all: they’re solution oriented and looking to work in a quickly adapting tech environment. This role requires fluent Danish and English languages knowledge, both spoken and written. So if this sounds like you, apply to learn more! 
 What's in there for you:  
 
 An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment  
 Daily catered lunch including vegetarian options, additionally the office is stocked with breakfast items, healthy snacks, and drinks.  
 Pension scheme 
 Medical Insurance which is covered under the pension scheme mentioned above .  
 Flexport employees in Denmark are insured and covered under the rules and regulations set up between Employer and Employee. 
 30 vacation days a year  
 Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success. 
 Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members 
 Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child. 
 
 #LI-onsite 

 Commitment to Equal Opportunity 
 At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. 
 Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants 
 Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at  www.flexport.com/privacy  for additional information.

The sales development organization plays a critical role in Navan's growth. As a company that values innovation, Navan relies on the sales development team to identify and qualify potential customers, generate leads, and set up meetings for our ambitious sales team. 
 The sales development team is responsible for researching and identifying target companies and decision makers, engaging with prospects through various channels, and using their industry expertise and knowledge to introduce our market-leading suite of products and services.  
 The sales development organization is the bedrock of success at Navan. By ensuring that every member of the sales development team is well-equipped, trained, and successful, we are creating a strong foundation for our sales efforts and position ourselves for long-term success. We are looking for individuals who have a passion for sales, embody a “go- getter” attitude, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You can expect world-class training and enablement resulting in rapid promotion into various parts of the business.  
   
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Actively outbound prospect (cold-calling and messaging) and qualify outbound leads and inquiries 
 Work alongside Account Executives to develop strategies to land outbound prospects and accounts 
 Effectively partner and work across the sales and marketing teams, providing feedback through our internal systems on lead quality 
 Act as the subject matter expert on Navan’s suite of product offerings (Travel & Expense)  
 Leverage tools such as SFDC, Outreach, Zoominfo, Chorus, and Sales Navigator to build your book of business and up-level your sales ability  
 Be mindful of your metrics and leveraging data to drive decision making 
 Consistently achieve quota by helping strategize on effective outbound plays 
 
 What We’re Looking For: 
 
 6+ months of prior sales development or other relevant experience 
 Adaptability, coachability, high drive and sense of urgency - comfortable working within a fast-paced environment 
 Strong communication and ability to clearly articulate complex concepts and technologies to diverse audiences including C-level executives 
 Detail-oriented and ability to stay organized in the midst of working potentially hundred of leads 
 Experience and success with cold-calling/prospecting, knows what it’s like to have a monthly quota 
 Proven track record of hitting or exceeding sales targets

jobs.title: Event & Field Marketing Manager – East / Central
jobs.excerpt:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.  
 Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. 
 Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the Role 
 We’re looking for an Event & Field Marketing Manager – East / Central to join Cresta’s Revenue Marketing team. This role owns strategy, execution, and performance across a high-volume portfolio of field marketing programs — from industry events and executive dinners to regional programs, roadshows, customer experiences, and partner activations. 
 This isn’t an events-for-events-sake role. Field Marketing is a meaningful pipeline channel at Cresta, and you’ll partner closely with Sales to determine where we invest, which accounts and audiences we target, and how programs contribute to pipeline creation and acceleration. 
 You’ll typically own 8–10+ programs per quarter and be responsible for taking them from initial strategy through execution, Sales follow-up, measurement, and optimization. 
 Location: This is a remote role supporting our East region. We strongly prefer candidates currently based on the U.S. East Coast , but are open to candidates in the Central U.S. who can easily support Eastern time zones and regional travel. This role requires approximately 20–30% travel , with heavier travel during peak event seasons. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Own Field Strategy + Execution: Build and execute field marketing programs aligned to regional Sales priorities, target accounts, and pipeline goals. 
 Drive Pipeline + ROI: Set program KPIs, track sourced and influenced pipeline, measure conversion and ROI, and translate results into clear recommendations. 
 Partner Closely with Sales: Work with Sales before, during, and after programs on account targeting, attendance, meetings, follow-up, and opportunity acceleration. 
 Manage a High-Volume Portfolio: Own 8–10+ programs per quarter across tradeshows, executive dinners, roadshows, customer programs, regional activations, and partner events. 
 Own Programs End-to-End: Manage strategy, budgets, vendors, contracts, promotion, attendee experience, onsite execution, and post-event reporting. 
 Make Smart Investment Decisions: Evaluate program performance, forecast spend, identify trade-offs, and shift investment toward the programs driving the strongest business impact. 
 Build Integrated Campaigns: Partner with Demand Gen, Digital, Product Marketing, Partnerships, and Sales to drive attendance and engagement across target accounts. 
 Create Standout Experiences: Bring new ideas and formats to the table that differentiate Cresta and create meaningful experiences for customers and prospects. 
 Build Repeatable Playbooks: Develop processes and workflows that allow the field marketing motion to scale as Cresta grows. 
 Support Executive Programs: Partner with Cresta executives and Sales leaders on messaging, speaker preparation, executive experiences, and customer engagement. 
 
 Qualifications 
 
 3–5+ years of B2B field marketing, regional marketing, event marketing, or integrated campaign experience 
 Experience owning field programs end-to-end , from strategy through execution and measurement 
 Comfortable managing 8–10+ concurrent programs per quarter in a fast-moving environment 
 Strong understanding of pipeline, revenue attribution, conversion, and event ROI 
 Proven experience partnering directly with Sales on account targeting, program strategy, and follow-up 
 Experience managing program budgets, vendors, contracts, and competing priorities 
 Strong communicator who can work effectively across Sales, Marketing, executives, agencies, and external partners 
 Currently based in the Eastern or Central U.S., with a strong preference for East Coast 
 Willing and able to travel approximately 20–30% 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS or startup environment 
 Experience with AI, Contact Center, Customer Experience, or adjacent enterprise technology 
 Experience supporting enterprise or strategic Sales teams 
 Experience with ABM/account-based field marketing programs 
 Previous Sales/SDR experience or strong understanding of enterprise Sales processes 
 Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, and field marketing/event tools such as Mobly 
 
 Perks & Benefits 
 
 Medical, dental, and vision plans designed to fit you and your family’s needs 
 Flexible vacation time to support a healthy work-life blend 
 Paid parental leave 
 Monthly gym and phone allowance 
 Work-from-home office stipend 
 Lunches and dinners for in-office employees via Grubhub 
 
 Compensation at Cresta 
 Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.
