Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities.  About the team 
 Build, improve, diagnose, fix, and measure things. Have outsized impact in your role supporting a rapidly scaling sales organization! The GTM sales team at Stripe works with new and existing businesses of all shapes and sizes. As a member of the Central Sales Strategy and Operations team, you’ll be responsible for overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with senior sales leadership and the broader sales team to provide insights and analysis on core business performance metrics and drive key strategic sales initiatives. 
 What you’ll do 
 Partnering closely with the GTM leadership team, regional sales leaders to support sales teams, owning the in-depth monitoring and tracking of the business metrics, creation of key intelligence and insights to accelerate growth.  
 Partner with key cross-functional stakeholders, including but not limited to Marketing, Finance & Strategy, Data Science, Seller Systems, and Strategic Operations to streamline and optimize our internal processes and run-the-business and planning deliverables (Stripe Rhythm of Business: Weekly Business Reviews, Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews). Shape the processes and go-to-market support model for a rapidly growing company, and make a tangible impact on sales and operations. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Support the GTM leadership with intelligence and insight to accelerate growth 
 Support Sales Strategy and Operations colleagues by standardizing global and regional common process that is currently decentralized

 Identify new opportunities and areas of productivity efficiency gains for Regional sales leadership 
 Participate in projects defining go-to-market approaches, as well as in regular business and resource planning 
 Run analysis on key performance metrics, providing relevant insights for managing the business

 Manage bespoke projects and effectively manage stakeholders 
 
 Who you are

 Minimum requirements 
 
 Has 7+ years of sales, strategy and operations experience in a high-tech growth environment, or operational experience in investment banking or management consulting or private equity or venture capital, or business insights / analytics roles 
 Advanced proficiency in SQL and other advanced analytics tools 
 Proficiency in BI visualization tools 
 Experience leveraging AI to analyze data / derive insights, automate processes, or create reports / dashboards 
 Has strong analytical skills and a structured approach to solving unique business problems. Has experience working with data and large data sets to identify trends and create insights to make recommendations to senior leaders 
 Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality 
 Works well with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, often ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/software company 
 Prior experience in the payments industry

jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The Business Value Consulting team focuses on driving long-term growth and value creation for Stripe's largest and most strategic users. The team quantifies the financial and strategic impact of Stripe's platform (from revenue optimization to operational efficiency) and translates that into the business cases that underpin Stripe's largest and most complex deals. We help drive meaningful business outcomes and accelerate decision-making through a consultative approach that aims to build investment confidence and elevate CxO conversations. 
 The GTM Business Value Specialist joins at a moment when the BVC team is expanding its impact across Stripe’s broader GTM organization through systematic programs, financial modeling, thought leadership, and data-driven insights. Work produced by the GTM Business Value Specialist will directly influence Stripe’s most consequential deals. 
 What you'll do 
 The GTM Business Value Specialist is a new role that requires intellectual curiosity, judgment, proactivity, analytical rigor, and strong communication skills. They partner closely with the broader team to design and operationalize programmatic tooling, economic frameworks, data-driven financial models, and user-facing presentations that deal teams will deploy in Stripe’s most complex and high-stakes customer conversations. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Financial model development and ownership: Design, build, QA, and maintain enterprise-grade value tools (ROI and TCO models, payback and NPV analyses, sensitivity and scenario models, competitive benchmarks) 
 Automation and tooling: Engineer integrations between Stripe's internal data sources and value-delivery tooling to automate the generation of financial outputs, narratives, and sales artifacts at scale 
 Assumptions governance: Build and maintain a documented, version-controlled assumptions library with sourced benchmarks, sign-off workflows, and audit trails, ensuring every model is defensible in a senior customer or board-level context 
 Usage instrumentation: Instrument tools to track GTM adoption, depth of engagement, and output usage. Bring the same analytical rigor to measuring the program's own impact that you apply to the models themselves 
 Scalable solutions: Create reusable templates and modules and build a library of repeatable solutions that accelerate value delivery across the organization 
 Cross-functional partnership: Coordinate across various teams at Stripe to keep benchmarks current and credible, ensure broad scale adoption, and develop innovative solutions 
 
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 2–4 years of professional experience in management consulting, strategy consulting, investment banking, corporate finance, strategic finance, or a fintech, SaaS, or technology role with financial exposure 
 Strong business analysis and financial modeling skills (unit economics, ROI and TCO analysis, sensitivity and scenario modeling, NPV and payback calculations) 
 Effective cross-functional communication and ability to translate between financial outcomes and technical products in simple terms 
 Excellent attention to detail with a governance mindset as assumptions must be sourced, versioned, and defensible 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Experience building interactive tools or analytical models for broad use 
 Experience with BI/visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Mode) for building dashboards and adoption analytics 
 Exposure to value consulting, deal pricing, or commercial strategy in a SaaS/enterprise technology environment 
 Working coding experience applied to analytics, automation, or data workflows (Python, SQL, or JavaScript) 
 Degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead, Form Now
jobs.excerpt:
About Formlabs: 
 Do you want to change how the world creates? 
 At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. 
 We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. 
 About Form Now 
 Form Now is a startup within Formlabs, backed by a small, fast-moving team of about 20 people. It's the next step in furthering Formlabs' mission: giving anyone, from individual builders to engineering teams, access to high-quality 3D printing without owning a printer. Users upload a model, choose from high quality materials, and Formlabs handles production, bridging the gap between idea and reality without the upfront cost of a machine. As the sole marketer for this business, you'll have full ownership of a marketing function and the challenge of scaling it from the ground up. 
 Your Impact:  
 We're looking for a Marketing Generalist to own growth for Form Now end to end. We need someone who can wear many hats, from working on customer acquisition, to launching and iterating quickly on new campaigns. You'll need to be strong analytically, comfortable running email, events, and LinkedIn outreach, and willing to try channels you haven't touched before. You'll work directly with leadership to connect what the product can do with how we message and sell it to new customers. 
 Breadth matters more than depth here. We'd rather have someone who can move fast across five channels than someone who's only ever gone deep on one. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Use analytics to identify where Form Now should grow next: which customer segments, which channels, and which campaigns are actually working 
 Own campaign effectiveness end to end: set up email and LinkedIn campaigns, run them, and measure what drove results 
 Independently plan and execute events as a channel for reaching new B2B customers, from small businesses to medium and large accounts 
 Connect Form Now's product roadmap to marketing: turn what the product does into positioning and messaging that lands with buyers 
 Pull together campaign analysis, competitive tracking, and channel experiments into a coherent growth plan you own end to end 
 Make A/B testing and fast iteration a habit rather than an occasional exercise; ship, measure, adjust, repeat 
 Write and manage customer-facing copy and email, from acquisition sequences to lifecycle messaging 
 Use AI tools, including Claude, as a daily part of the job to move faster on research, campaign builds, and analysis 
 
 About You: 
 
 2-10 years of B2B marketing or growth experience; slope and grit matter more than years 
 A track record of taking on projects solo, from concept through execution, and knowing how you measured success 
 Comfortable being customer-facing when the job calls for it 
 Strong analytically: you can build a manageable tracking system, read your own campaign data, and act on it without waiting for someone else to hand you a dashboard 
 Have run or set up events independently 
 Growth mindset: you're not precious about the channel you know best and you'll try new approaches quickly 
 High energy and not afraid to be scrappy; a startup-within-a-startup environment means undefined problems and few guardrails 
 Use AI tools fluently in your daily work, held to the same quality bar as your own 
 
 Bonus Skills:  
 
 B2B experience specifically 
 Experience with data analytics and visualization tools (GBQ/SQL, DataStudio/Looker, etc.) 
 Comfortable with copywriting and customer marketing, even if it's not your primary strength 
 You've built your own tools, whether that's a scraper for a prospect list, an automation that stitches two tools together, or a landing page you shipped without waiting for design. 
 
 Our Benefits & Perks: 
 
 Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs 
 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) 
 401K matching and access to financial advisors 
 Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks) 
 Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks) 
 Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it 
 Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits 
 Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats 
 Regular sponsored professional development opportunities 
 Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community 
 And of course… unlimited 3D prints 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.   
 Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing. 
   Compensation 
 We are all owners of Formlabs and direct beneficiaries of our success. We believe that equity is a critical component of compensation at Formlabs, and we want our newest team members to understand the potential value of their equity compensation. Full time employees receive equity, in the form of RSUs. Your financial investment will grow with us in accordance to your impact. 
 At Formlabs, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, location and expected impact on the organization. The annual base pay range for this role is: $85,000 — $145,000 USD

jobs.title: GTM Partner Acquisition & Development
jobs.excerpt:
The Channel and Ecosystems team is dedicated to accelerating Asana's growth and market reach through partnerships and fostering a thriving partner network . We build and nurture relationships with Channel Partners, Technology Partners, and Strategic Alliances to support Asana customers across geographies . In this GTM Partner Acquisition & Development role, you will be Asana's tip of the spear for identifying, recruiting, and activating a new generation of partners to drive our platform evolution from work management to an AI-powered operating system . You will turn promising strategic relationships into high-performing, revenue-generating partnerships across our global ecosystem . 
 T his role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule . The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday . Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays . Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner . If you're i nterviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements . 
 What you’ll achieve 
 
 Develop and execute a strategic partner recruitment plan targeting a new generation of GTM partners aligned to Asana's platform evolution . 
 Identify, evaluate, and recruit partners with proven capabilities in sales, technical solutioning, consulting, change management, and professional services . 
 Establish, grow, and advise C-level and VP-level relationships at target partner organizations to position Asana's platform vision . 
 Architect joint business plans defining shared revenue goals, go-to-market strategy, pipeline targets, and comprehensive enablement plans . 
 Drive tight field alignment between partner sellers and Asana's direct sales team for seamless co-selling and opportunity management . 
 Work cross-functionally with marketing, partner programs, customer success, and solutions engineering to build a surround-support model for partners . 
 Establish clear KPIs, performance scorecards, and QBR frameworks to track partner health, pipeline contribution, and partner-sourced/influenced revenue . 
 
 About you 
 
 Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making . 
 Track record in channel partnerships, partner development, or strategic alliances within SaaS or enterprise software . 
 Demonstrated success recruiting and activating new partners from scratch . 
 Deep familiarity with the GTM partner ecosystem (SIs, consultancies, technology advisors) and adjacent technology ecosystems (e.g., Atlassian, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft) . 
 Strong executive presence with the ability to engage, advise, and present effectively to partner C-suites and senior leadership . 
 Strong grasp of AI-powered SaaS platforms and the ability to internalize and evangelize Asana’s Work Graph® and platform capabilities . 
 Collaborative mindset with experience working acro ss marketing, sales, product, and customer success teams to drive growth . 
 Data-driven approach with experience b uilding partner scorecards, QBR frameworks, and performance dashboards . 
 
 At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgr ounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission . If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply . 
 What we’ll offer 
 Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to ach ieving our mission . We believe that compensation should be reflect ive of the value you create relative to the market value of your role . To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity aud it . 
 For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $255,000 - $296,100 . The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objec tively assessed during the interview process . The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified . 
 In addition to base salary, your compensation pack age may include additional components such as equi ty, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits . If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role . 
 We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include: 
 
 Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits 
 Career coaching & support 
 Inclusive family building benefits 
 Long-term savings or retirement plans 
 In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences 
 
 These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

 Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. With 13+ offices all over the world, we are always looking for individuals who care about building technology that drives positive change in the world and a culture where everyone feels that they belong. 
 We believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive. Our goal is to ensure that Asana upholds an environment where all people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are applying for an open position or working at the company. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 As the Public Sector Solutions Marketing Lead at Anthropic, you will be the strategic architect of our agency, federal, state, local and international government marketing efforts, positioning Claude as the trusted AI partner for policy makers, public sector knowledge workers and beyond.  This is a pivotal role that requires deep understanding of the public sector ecosystem combined with the ability to craft compelling positioning and messaging around AI's  benefit to citizens and residents worldwide. 
 You’ll serve as the dedicated marketing interface for Anthropic's Public Sector teams, owning the coordination and execution between public sector initiatives and Anthropic's broader marketing function. Working closely with sales, product, partnerships and communications teams, you’ll be responsible for bringing public sector launches, features, and messaging to market through various channels while ensuring cohesive positioning across audiences.  
 This role demands someone who can set vision and strategy while being hands-on with execution—from launching product capabilities like Claude for Government and sector-specific MCP integrations, to quarterbacking demand generation campaigns that drive adoption. Working at the intersection of AI ethics, global development, and growth marketing, you'll help shape industry conversations around responsible AI deployment while driving measurable pipeline and impact results. 
 Key responsibilities 

 Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategy for Public Sector across key verticals: federal agencies, state and local government, defense, regulatory bodies, public utilities and more. 

 Craft differentiated positioning and messaging across solutions pages, campaign materials and content for distinct audiences within the vertical. 

 Lead go-to-market for product and solution launches including sector-specific offerings and relevant MCP integrations and skills (LMS platforms, nonprofit, scientific research tools, etc.). 

 Partner with communications on executive thought leadership regarding AI's potential to benefit underserved communities, including flagship announcements in the context of key initiatives like Claude for Government. 

 Work with the social and content teams on a public sector content calendar that highlights use cases, case studies, and partnership announcements. 

 Drive thought leadership initiatives and speaking / event opportunities relevant to the public sector  

 Enable sales teams with compelling materials, outbound campaigns, and pipeline-driving initiatives for public sector enterprise accounts and higher education institutions 

 Report on which channels and campaigns are driving results and identify opportunities for iteration  

 Minimum qualifications 
 
 Direct experience marketing software products, owning the messaging and positioning strategy, to government audiences, including familiarity with federal, state/local, or international public sector procurement processes 
 Operated in a 0-to-1 building environment or startup company —can build processes where none exist and navigate ambiguity across a complex stakeholder landscape ration and campaign execution 
 Adaptable generalist with exposure and competency within multiple marketing functions (content, campaigns, social, analytics, sales enablement)  
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to translate complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical audiences  
 Quick learner who can absorb context on diverse government verticals and procurement cycles rapidly  
 Excel at cross-functional collaboration—comfortable being the connective tissue between product, sales, partnerships, communications, and marketing teams. 
 Passionate about AI's potential to benefit underserved communities while maintaining focus on responsible, equitable deployment 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 8+ years of product marketing experience, with at least 2 years of experience marketing software, government technology to public sector and federal audiences 
 Have worked in or with public sector organizations and understand the distinct priorities and decision-making dynamics of government buyers  
 Possess experience with event marketing at public sector conferences (e.g., GovTech, ACT-IAC, NGA, NIST-adjacent events)  
 Have a background in enterprise sales enablement, particularly in complex or regulated industries 
 Show a track record of building marketing programs from scratch at a growth-stage company  
 Demonstrate interest in the responsible deployment of AI in public-facing contexts, including an awareness of the ethical considerations unique to government use cases 
 
 Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect staff to be able to work from our San Francisco, New York, or Washington, D.C. office at least 2 days a week. We encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. 
   The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. jobs.title: Solutions Marketing Manager, Cybersecurity
jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 You will be a strategic contributor to our cybersecurity marketing efforts, positioning Claude as the trusted AI partner for CISOs, security operations teams, threat intelligence analysts and beyond. This is an important role that requires deep understanding of the cybersecurity ecosystem combined with the ability to craft compelling positioning and messaging around AI's benefit to defenders and the organizations they protect. 
 Working closely with sales, product, partnerships and communications teams, you'll be responsible for bringing cybersecurity launches, features, and messaging to market through various channels while ensuring cohesive positioning across audiences. 
 This role needs someone who can set vision and strategy while being hands-on with execution, from launching product capabilities for security operations and sector-specific tools to quarterbacking demand generation campaigns that drive adoption. Working at the intersection of AI safety, the evolving threat landscape, and campaigns, you'll help shape industry conversations around AI's role in cyber defense that drive measurable pipeline and impact results. 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 Coordinate and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy for cybersecurity across key segments: enterprise security operations, threat intelligence, detection and response, governance/risk/compliance, MSSPs and more 
 Craft differentiated positioning and messaging across solutions pages, campaign materials and content for distinct audiences within the vertical 
 Support go-to-market for product and solution launches including sector-specific offerings and relevant MCP integrations and skills (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence platforms, etc.) 
 Partner with the alliances team on joint go-to-market with cybersecurity partners, including shared positioning, launch coordination, and integrated campaign moments across security platform and services partners 
 Partner with communications on executive thought leadership regarding AI's potential to tip the balance toward defenders, including flagship announcements in the context of key security initiatives 
 Work with the social and content teams on a cybersecurity content calendar that highlights use cases, case studies, and partnership announcements 
 Drive thought leadership initiatives and speaking / event opportunities relevant to the security community 
 Enable sales teams with compelling materials, outbound campaigns, and pipeline-driving initiatives for security-led enterprise accounts 
 Report on which channels and campaigns are driving results and identify opportunities for iteration 
 
 Minimum qualifications 
 
 Have direct experience marketing software products to security audiences, including familiarity with how CISOs, SOC leaders, and security engineering teams evaluate and buy technology 
 Thrive in a 0-to-1 environment — can build processes where none exist and navigate ambiguity across a complex stakeholder landscape 
 Are an adaptable generalist with exposure and competency within multiple marketing functions (content, campaigns, social, analytics, sales enablement) 
 Have strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to translate complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for both technical practitioners and non-technical audiences 
 Are a quick learner who can absorb context on security workflows, buyer dynamics, and compliance frameworks rapidly 
 Excel at cross-functional collaboration — comfortable being the connective tissue between product, sales, partnerships, communications, and marketing teams 
 Are passionate about AI's potential to strengthen cyber defense while maintaining focus on responsible, safe deployment 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Have 8+ years of marketing experience with at least 2 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, or the broader security technology space 
 Have worked in or with security organizations and understand the distinct priorities and decision-making dynamics of security buyers 
 Possess experience with event marketing at security conferences (e.g., RSA Conference, Black Hat, Gartner Security & Risk, ISAC events) 
 Have a background in enterprise sales enablement, particularly in complex or regulated industries 
 Show a track record of building marketing programs from scratch at a growth-stage company 
 Demonstrate interest in the responsible deployment of AI in security contexts, including an awareness of the dual-use considerations unique to cybersecurity use cases 
 
 Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect staff to be able to work from our Washington, D.C. or San Francisco office at least once a month for cross-functional stakeholder engagement. We encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $255,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings. 
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. An overview of this role 
 As an Associate Revenue Operations Analyst, Policy & Rules of Engagement, you will help the Field Sales team apply go-to-market policies consistently. You will learn to support requests and policy-related disputes, maintain documentation and data, and help make processes easier to understand and use. This is an entry-level, remote role aligned to time zones in the United States. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Support the documentation and maintenance of go-to-market policies and rules of engagement for the Field Sales team. 
 Respond to policy questions and support the resolution of policy-related disputes through Salesforce Chatter, case requests, and the Sales Support Slack channel. 
 Apply established policies carefully and identify questions that need escalation. 
 Maintain accurate data, process documentation, and best practices for first-tier sales teams. 
 Work with operations, strategy, sales compensation, and sales systems partners to support consistent processes. 
 Identify documentation or process gaps and share them with the appropriate team members. 
 Support policy updates and annual planning activities as business needs change. 
 
 What you’ll bring 
 
 Interest in revenue or sales operations, policies, and the systems that support go-to-market teams. 
 Experience working carefully with data, documentation, or administrative processes through coursework, internships, projects, or previous roles. 
 Ability to review information closely, identify issues, and document clear next steps. 
 Ability to organize multiple requests, prioritize work, and meet deadlines. 
 Clear written and verbal communication skills for working with stakeholders across teams. 
 Interest in supporting policy application and resolving questions or disputes fairly and consistently. 
 Demonstrated curiosity by asking questions, learning new processes, and taking ownership of assigned work. 
 Salesforce administration experience or familiarity with Salesforce is a plus. 
 
 About the team 
 The Revenue Operations team supports go-to-market teams by building and maintaining the processes, policies, and systems they use to serve customers. We work asynchronously with partners across GitLab to make rules of engagement clear, consistent, and scalable as business needs evolve. 
 The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.  Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being 
 Flexible Paid Time Off  
 Team Member Resource Groups

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.excerpt:
Who We Are 
 At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people. 
 We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you. 
 We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team. 
 Our Values 
 If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in. Who You Are 
 You’re proactive, ambitious, and energized by solving problems and creating opportunities. You’re curious about how businesses operate, enjoy connecting with people, and communicate clearly and confidently. You stay organized, learn quickly, and bring a strong work ethic and positive attitude to everything you do. 
 This role is a strong foundation for a long-term career across sales, customer success, marketing, revenue operations, and broader go-to-market leadership. This role has a clear path to internal mobility with many of our top performers going on to grow into other roles across the business. 
 At Justworks, we’re building a modern pipeline generation engine that combines thoughtful human engagement with smarter tools, better signals, and more efficient workflows. We’re looking for people who are curious, adaptable, productive, highly motivated, and excited to grow alongside the evolution of modern go-to-market teams. 
 What You’ll Work On 
 As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Justworks, you’ll play a key role in growing our outbound pipeline and generating new business opportunities. This role will spend about 70% of your day contacting, prospecting, and researching potential customers. 
 You will: 
 
 Own outbound prospecting and pipeline generation within your assigned territory or segment 
 Research and identify prospective customers using a combination of data, tools, and market signals 
 Execute outbound outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels to engage decision-makers 
 Generate qualified sales conversations and build pipeline for Account Executives 
 Learn and effectively use modern sales tools and workflows to improve productivity and outreach quality 
 Conduct thoughtful, value-driven conversations focused on understanding customer needs 
 Develop expertise in Justworks, our product suite, and the broader HR/PEO landscape 
 Continuously refine your messaging, prospecting approach, and workflow efficiency 
 
 Your Success Profile 
 We’re looking for individuals who embody our core values and demonstrate curiosity, ownership, adaptability, coachability, collaboration, and a strong customer mindset. 
 Successful SDRs at Justworks tend to be: 
 Results-Oriented You’re motivated by goals, accountable for outcomes, and willing to put in the work to improve and succeed. 
 Curious & Adaptable You learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions, and are open to evolving your approach as tools, workflows, and customer expectations change. 
 Operationally Minded You stay organized, manage your time well, and look for ways to work smarter and more efficiently. 
 Strong Communicators You can simplify complex topics, communicate clearly, and build trust quickly through thoughtful, customer-focused conversations.

jobs.title: Program Manager, GTM Planning
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 Stripe’s GTM Planning team partners with Sales Leadership, Finance, Product, and Legal to drive operational excellence to support our GTM strategy. We bring expertise, rigorous thinking, and a user-first approach to problem solving. We transform, improve and support global Stripe business processes to drive critical initiatives and other cross-functional business priorities for the sales planning cycle. 
 What you’ll do 
 
 Project Management: 
 
 Lead and manage day-to-day operations of large-scale transformational projects 
 Develop detailed project plans, set milestones, and ensure program integrity 
 Standardize reporting and systems requirements 
 
 Identify needs and create solutions: 
 
 Design solutions for process improvements and tool development, focusing on long-term sustainability and scalability of planning 
 Analyze and evaluate emerging challenges and opportunities, focusing on long term repeatable processes 
 
 Stakeholder management: 
 
 Coordinate with key stakeholders and leadership to align complex programs and secure buy-in, while balancing prioritization 
 Partner cross-functionally across all departments (Finance, Legal, Systems, etc.) to influence and execute 

 Responsibilities 
 
 Be accountable for building and driving large-scale transformational initiatives end to end 
 Create strong business cases and drive influence to gain cross-functional support and resources needed to accomplish your goals; use data to influence decisions 
 Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks that could impact the successful delivery of programs 
 Create roadmaps, project plans, change management plans, tasks and reporting methodologies to track progress 
 Execute through cross-functional teams 
 Manage change management activities across stakeholder engagement, including messaging/communication planning, support and enablement 
 Influence and adopt the use of tooling, including AI-based levers, to make the planning processes more efficient 
 
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 7+ years of program management, business operations, or management consulting experience, preferably in a GTM/Sales Operations organization. 
 Demonstrated organizational, project management and execution skills with ability to own cross-functional projects 
 An ability to drive sales territory planning and align strategies across all segments to ensure seamless execution 
 Strong track record as a strategic, analytical problem solver and skilled operator with the demonstrated ability to successfully deploy new initiatives end to end 
 A high degree of comfort working quickly in a high growth and fast-paced environment 
 An ability to seamlessly transition from the high level to very detailed, and a willingness to “roll up your sleeves” 
 A detail-oriented and analytical individual with business acumen, and the ability to influence and communicate within all levels of the organization 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Knowledge of Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) systems 
 Data Analytics (Google Sheets/Excel data manipulation, SQL)

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
The Asana Marketing team is responsible for fueling business growth and building a brand customers love . We create campaigns and content to attract new accounts and inspire current ones to grow with us . We continue to grow, with a global team focused on revenue and field marketing, product marketing, brand and content cre ation, advertising, and lifecycle marketing . 
 As a Field Marketing Manager, you will be a critical contributor on our Revenue Marketing team, working cross-functionally to develop our go-to-market strategy and execute campaigns that create and accelerate sales pipeline . Reporting to the AMER Field Marketing Lead, you will partner closely with regional sales leaders to align marketing strategy with sales goals through a mix of digital campaigns, experiential events, executive roundtables, and ABM . You will make data-driven decisions and adapt quickly to industry imperatives to customize our marketing progr ams and maximize impact . 
 This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule . The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday . Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays . Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partn er . If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements . 
 What you’ll achieve 
 
 Program Ownership: Develop and own the field marketing program for North America across owned and sponsored events from concept through completion, including planning, budgeting, vendor management, and reporting . 
 Pipeline Acceleration: Partner closely with revenue leaders, field sales reps, and SDRs on pre- and post-show strategies to engage target audiences and maximize pipeline generation . 
 Cross-Functional Event Execution: Collaborate with internal partners on Asana-hosted events across ABM, Brand, Community, and Customer Advocacy . 
 Scalable Best Practices: Establish and refine repeatable processes, templates, and best practices for regional field marketing activities . 
 Performance & ROI Tracking: Own the tracking and reporting of program results, closely monitoring event KPIs, lead flow, pipeline creation, and overall program ROI . 
 
 About you 
 
 Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making. 
 4+ years of field marketing experience, ideally for enterprise B2B/SaaS audiences . 
 Deep event planning and management knowledge with a proven track record of successfully executing multifaceted events across tight timelines . 
 Strong relationship-builder with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, work with executives and high-profile speakers, and drive buy-in from sales leadership . 
 Operationally minded self-starter with high autonomy, strong project management skills, and the ability to adapt to fast-paced environments . 
 Working knowledg e of marketing technology tools (Salesforce, Marketo, or similar platforms) and comfort utilizing data to drive campaign de cisions . 
 Ability to travel regionally as needed . 
 
 At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, per spectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve o ur mission . If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply . 
 Wh at we’ll offer 
 
 Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission . We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you crea te relative to the market value of your role . To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit . 
 For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $133,000 - $151,000 . The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process . The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified . 
 In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits . If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensa tion and benefits for this role . 
 We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include : 
 
 Mental health, wellness & fitness ben efits 
 Career coaching & support 
 Inclusive family building benefits 
 Long-term savings or retirement plans 
 In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences 
 
 These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations . If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role .

jobs.excerpt:
The Company You’ll Join 
 Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work. 
 For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page . The Problems You’ll Solve 
 Carta Law represents a unique opportunity: we're establishing a category and shifting how private capital firms think about legal and compliance operations. As a Demand Generation Marketing Manager focused on Carta Law, you'll build the campaigns and positioning that establish Carta Law as the category leader—driving awareness, pipeline, and revenue growth among our target buyers. You'll work to: 
 Demand Generation Strategy and Management 
 
 Collaborates closely with Carta GTM teams (including Marketing, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Ops) to jointly develop and execute demand generation strategies tailored to the tailored to General Counsels, Chief Compliance Officers, and Heads of Legal at enterprise PE and VC firms—driving awareness, pipeline, and revenue growth. 
 Coordinates cross-functional efforts to ensure seamless execution of demand generation campaigns, leveraging insights from product, sales, and customer teams to optimize targeting and messaging. 
 Develops robust multichannel demand gen plans on an annual and quarterly basis, aligning stakeholders across Carta to roll out impactful campaigns with clear goals, resource allocation (time, people, budget), and key performance indicators (KPIs). 
 Works resourcefully within organizational constraints (budget, approvals, timing), iteratively testing creative tactics and adjusting programs based on performance data to maximize pipeline and conversion among General Counsels. 
 Maintains strong internal stakeholder relationships and ensures responsive communication to drive alignment and address input, feedback, and requests relating to lead generation and conversion. 
 
 Marketing Communications and Enablement 
 
 Partners with Carta sales, product, and customer advisory teams to deeply understand the decision journeys, pain points, and informational needs of our target  audiences, informing content development and campaign design. 
 Collaborates with content and customer marketing to produce mid- to bottom-funnel assets (case studies, product guides, customer success stories, webinars, solution briefs, nurture emails) tailored to customer needs and Carta’s value proposition. 
 Surfaces and shares impactful customer stories and pipeline deals to derive insights, demonstrate value, and drive replication of effective demand gen tactics. 
 Works with web, performance marketing, and digital teams to create and optimize landing pages, digital content, and conversion points for ICP-focused campaigns. 
 Interfaces with the social and content marketing teams to activate compelling content on LinkedIn, Twitter, and other networks, amplifying reach and engagement among target audiences. 
 Partners with product marketing to evolve tailored messaging and positioning as new product features and Carta Law-specific solutions are launched. 
 Coordinates with communications and PR to ensure a consistent story and support for major news, campaigns, launches, and thought leadership. 
 Articulates Carta Law's differentiation as an AI-native legal services platform that delivers speed, compliance, and cost efficiency at a fraction of traditional law firm rates—translating this value proposition into messaging that resonates with GPs and fund operations teams. 
 
 Events and Field Marketing 
 
 Partners with Events  team to develop and execute geo-targeted campaigns and networking opportunities in key hubs (e.g., New York, San Francisco, London), aligning content, speakers, and topics to Carta Law’s target customer’s interests. 
 Identifies and recruits top industry voices and Carta executives for event speaking engagements to strengthen credibility and thought leadership. 
 Drives event promotion, registration, and follow-up activities with an eye on pipeline acceleration and maximizing engagement. 
 Collaborates with lifecycle marketing to nurture prospect attendees and convert event interest into meaningful sales opportunities. 
 
 The Team You’ll Work With 
 You’ll be joining our Integrated Marketing team, reporting directly to the Director of Demand Generation and Field Marketing.  The Carta marketing team plays a vital role in our growth across all products, audiences and sectors.  
 About You 
 
 Exceptional relationship management skills with internal stakeholders and executive leaders, especially across GTM teams (Sales, Product, Customer Success, Marketing, etc.). 
 Maturity and strategic acumen to independently drive high-impact demand generation programs targeting sophisticated GC audiences, while aligning cross-functional teams to shared goals. 
 Deep understanding of modern marketing functions—including digital, field, ABM, content, events, lifecycle—and proven ability to influence resources and priorities across teams to achieve demand generation objectives. 
 Strong track record of designing, executing, and optimizing multi-channel, data-driven campaigns that create pipeline and accelerate revenue, ideally for complex B2B, SaaS, fintech or financial services solutions. 
 Demonstrated expertise in collaborating cross-functionally with revenue teams and influencing senior leaders to advance marketing initiatives. 
 Outstanding communication, project management, and prioritization skills; thrives in a fast-paced, iterative environment. 
 BA required; experience marketing to institutional investors, GCs, or financial stakeholders highly desirable. 
 6+ years’ experience in GTM, demand generation, field marketing, or ABM roles—preferably with a focus on fintech, SaaS, or financial services audiences.  
 
 Salary 
 We are hiring for multiple levels and locations, so final offers may vary from the amounts listed based on geography, experience and expertise, and other factors. 
 Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:  
 
 $130,000 - $150,000  
 
 Final offers may vary from the amount listed based on geography, candidate experience and expertise, and other factors. Disclosures: 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.  
 Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details. 
 For information on our data privacy policies, see  Privacy ,  CA Candidate Privacy , and Brazil Transparency Report . 
 Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com or @carta-external.com domain. Report any contact from unapproved domains to security@carta.com.

 Conduct market and account research to identify regional opportunities, relevant audiences, and effective engagement strategies

 Ensure program performance, pipeline influence, and ROI are tracked consistently; use insights to optimize programs and improve outcomes

jobs.title: Talent Brand Manager
jobs.excerpt:
About Faire 
 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive. 
 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours. About this role 
 Faire is building an AI-enabled talent organization, hiring the people shaping the future of personalized commerce for retailers and brands around the world. We're looking for a Talent Brand Manager to build our employer value proposition and turn it into one cohesive talent brand strategy across all of our digital surfaces: LinkedIn, our careers site, social, Glassdoor, and increasingly, the AI tools candidates now use to research and compare offers. 
 This is a hands-on, builder role. You'll shape Faire's EVP, then build the systems that carry it to our employees, like building AI tools that make it easy for employees to tell their own stories and put our leaders' voices in front of candidates. You will also develop an AEO strategy that ensures Faire shows up as the clear, authentic answer when candidates ask LLMs to learn more about the company and compare offers. You'll give recruiters that same enablement, arming them with the narrative and objection-handling they need to authentically represent Faire in the market.  
 You'll report to Jenny Talwar, Head of Talent, and be based in San Francisco. 
 What you’ll do  
 
 Architect our employer value proposition: Define a compelling "why Faire, why now" narrative tailored for key hiring areas, beginning with our Engineering, Product, Design, and Data teams. Highlighting the broad range of backgrounds of the retailers and brands we serve, so the workforce we build increasingly reflects the diversity and vibrancy of our customers. 
 Create a unified digital footprint: Orchestrate high-impact campaigns across LinkedIn, Glassdoor, and our careers site to ensure a consistent talent brand backed by measurable performance indicators. 
 Establish Answer Engine Optimization: Develop an AEO framework to ensure Faire’s culture and opportunities are accurately and prominently represented within LLMs. 
 Champion the talent brand identity: Act as a steward for our voice, ensuring every job description and candidate touchpoint aligns perfectly with Faire’s established brand guidelines. 
 Scalable storytelling: Establish a repeatable engine for surfacing authentic stories from our leaders and employees that showcase our values, incredible internal mobility stories, and give a real glimpse into life at Faire.  
 Empower the front line: Create a comprehensive self-serve toolkit for recruiters and hiring managers, including audience-specific positioning and narrative-driven objection handling. 
 Build AI-powered enablers: Launch internal tools that leverage AI to help every Faire employee transform their personal experiences into polished, social-ready content. 
 Measure and iterate: Rigorously track candidate sentiment and conversion data to evaluate the effectiveness of our talent brand investments on hiring success. 
 Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Marketing and Comms partners to ensure a seamless integration of our employer brand across the business. 
 
 Qualifications 
 
 5+ years building employer brand, talent marketing, or recruitment marketing programs, ideally from the ground up 
 Experience running a cohesive brand strategy across owned and earned digital channels: careers site, LinkedIn, social, and Glassdoor 
 Comfortable building self-serve, custom AI tools for individual and team use, and applying them to drive productivity and scale 
 Understands how AI-driven search and answer engines (AEO/GEO) shape how a brand's content surfaces, and wants to build that muscle for talent brand 
 Exceptional writer and editor, able to turn complex, cross-functional work into a story people remember 
 Experience building recruiter enablement materials, including objection-handling content 
 Uses data (candidate feedback, funnel metrics, brand perception) to prioritize what to build and prove it worked 
 Strong cross-functional partner, with experience working across Recruiting, Marketing, Comms, and People teams to ship projects 

 California: the pay range for this role is $148,000 to $203,500 per year. 
 This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future. 

 Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting.

Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year.  Why you’ll love working at Faire 
 
 Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly. 
 Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day. 
 Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours. 
 Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work. 
 Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success. 
 
 Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog .

jobs.excerpt:
About Vercel: 
 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 
 For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 
 Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. 
 We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like  OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. About the Role: 
 You'll own paid acquisition at Vercel across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging channels, with one goal driving the work: scalable, profitable customer acquisition for our self-serve and enterprise motions. 
 This role is built for an analytical, AI-native growth marketer who cares about results, testing velocity, and scale. We want someone who has already wired AI into how they work, building agents, automations, and workflows that let them operate like a much larger team. You'll bring operational rigor to how we launch and scale campaigns, own the systems that make us faster, and turn our acquisition engine into a compounding growth loop. The work sits between strategy and execution, in close partnership with Product Marketing, Lifecycle, Creative, Data, and Marketing Operations, so the right message reaches the right developer or buyer in the right channel. 
 
 What You Will Do: 
 
 Paid acquisition end to end across Google Search and YouTube, Meta, LinkedIn, and emerging channels, driving signups, activations, and pipeline 
 Multi-million-dollar annual paid media spend, where you beat ROAS and CAC targets and lower CAC over time 
 AI-driven operating leverage, building agents, automations, and AI-assisted workflows that compress campaign turnaround and scale creative production 
 Creative and audience testing, where you systematically find (and sometimes design) winning creative and audience segments, using AI to generate and iterate variants at high velocity 
 Measurement and attribution, building funnel reports and cohort analyses with Analytics, and owning event-based tracking, pixels, and conversion APIs so the data stays clean 
 Performance reporting, where you surface actionable insights and clear recommendations to leadership on a regular cadence 
 Cross-functional alignment with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Lifecycle, Creative, and Marketing Operations on targeting, messaging, and down-funnel conversion 

 About You: 
 
 5+ years running and scaling paid performance campaigns at high-growth B2B SaaS, developer tools, or consumer tech companies 
 Demonstrated AI-native habits, where you reach for AI by default and have built agents, automations, or workflows that changed how you operate (if you've automated parts of your own job, that's a strong signal) 
 Hands-on expertise with Meta Ads, Google Search and YouTube, and LinkedIn Ads, with TikTok Ads or programmatic as a bonus 
 A track record managing $1M to $5M+ in annual paid media budgets and beating ROAS and CAC goals 
 Fluency in data and analytics and storytelling with campaign data and testing and evaluating audience performance 
 Strong copywriting instincts and taste in performance creative, and ability to scale taste with AI 
 Clear written and verbal communication that lands with both technical developers and enterprise buyers 
 A bias for action - you can just ship things. 

 Benefits: 
 
 Competitive compensation package, including equity. 
 Inclusive Healthcare Package. 
 Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. 
 Flexible Time Off. 
 We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. 
 
 The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $150,000 - $188,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.  
 Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

jobs.title: Event Specialist, Marketing
jobs.excerpt:
About Formlabs: 
 Do you want to change how the world creates? 
 At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. 
 We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. 
 Your Impact:  
 Trade shows and events are where Formlabs puts our products directly in front of the people who use them, and North America is one of our most active regions on the calendar. As Event Specialist, you'll be the right hand to our NA Events Managers - involved in every show from planning to final wrap-up, and building the hands-on expertise that experiential marketing careers are built on. 
 You'll own the details that make a booth come together: ordering printed collateral, preparing displays and product samples, keeping consumables stocked, and coordinating the shipping, vendors, and campaign materials behind every show. It's a fast-paced and high-visibility role.  
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Act as the right hand to the Marketing Managers, Events (NA), involved in the planning and execution of every trade show and company event on the North America calendar 
 Order and manage printed collateral (leaflets, brochures, signage), ensuring materials are on-brand, accurate, and delivered on time 
 Prepare, track, and pack display parts, demo units, and product samples for each show, making sure the right materials are ready to ship 
 Order and manage booth consumables and supplies (e.g., cleaning and setup supplies, packaging, printer/label materials) needed for smooth onsite execution 
 Track and maintain inventory of event materials, including demo units, signage, swag, 3D-printed demo parts, and booth hardware 
 Coordinate with recurring vendors and shipping/freight partners to ensure materials arrive on time and within budget 
 Maintain internal tools such as shipping calendars, logistics trackers, and asset management systems 
 Support post-show wrap-up: processing returns, documenting damage, and assisting with invoice reconciliation 
 Support execution of pre- and post-event marketing campaigns (email, social, promotional materials) in partnership with the Marketing Manager, Events 
 Help prepare internal enablement materials for booth staff, such as demo scripts, presentation decks, and talking points 
 Support onsite booth staffing coordination and scheduling 
 Assist with gathering event performance data (leads, attendance, engagement) and compiling post-event reports 
 Coordinate with the design team to ensure booth assets, signage, and collateral are on-brand and print-ready 
 Serve as onsite support at events, helping represent Formlabs to customers, partners, and prospects 
 Up to 25% travel across North America,  to assist with onsite event marketing tasks. 
 
 About You: 
 
 1–3 years of experience in events, marketing, or logistics coordination - through professional experience, internships, academic projects, or other hands-on involvement 
 Strong organizational and project management skills; comfortable managing multiple timelines and shifting priorities 
 Familiarity with event marketing fundamentals (campaigns, collateral, brand guidelines) and/or event logistics (freight, vendors, booth operations) 
 A proactive communicator who works well cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Design, and Logistics 
 A detail-oriented, get-it-done attitude, with comfort working independently on defined projects and asking for guidance on new or ambiguous problems 
 Comfortable traveling ~25% of the time 
 
 Bonus Skills:  
 
 Experience creating or supporting event marketing content (email, social, presentations) 
 Background in B2B tech or manufacturing 
 Familiarity with international shipping, customs paperwork, or exhibit house coordination 
 
 Our Benefits & Perks: 
 
 Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs 
 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) 
 401K matching and access to financial advisors 
 Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks) 
 Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks) 
 Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it 
 Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits 
 Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats 
 Regular sponsored professional development opportunities 
 Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community 
 And of course… unlimited 3D prints 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.   
 Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing. 
 Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here . Please give them a read. Compensation 
 We are all owners of Formlabs and direct beneficiaries of our success. We believe that equity is a critical component of compensation at Formlabs, and we want our newest team members to understand the potential value of their equity compensation. Full time employees receive equity, in the form of RSUs. Your financial investment will grow with us in accordance to your impact. 
 At Formlabs, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, location and expected impact on the organization. The annual base pay range for this role is: $75,000 — $95,000 USD
