Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. About the Role: 
 Vercel is seeking a Business Development Representative to help bring the next wave of innovative companies onto the Vercel platform. This role is ideal for individuals who are curious about web technologies and eager to launch their career in technical sales at one of the world’s leading developer tools companies. 
 As a Business Development Representative, you’ll play a key role in connecting with engineering and product leaders at fast-growing companies, educating them on how Vercel can help their teams ship faster and build better web experiences. You’ll work closely with Account Executives to identify, qualify, and nurture opportunities within the Majors segment — our largest enterprise customers. 
 This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll learn directly from world-class sales and product leaders, gain exposure to the SaaS sales cycle, and build a strong foundation for a career in go-to-market at Vercel.

 Passion for web development and staying current with the latest trends and technologies

jobs.title: GTM Enablement Manager (Technical)
jobs.excerpt:
OVERVIEW

At Apollo GraphQL, we're on a mission to make it radically easier for engineering teams to ship fast, reliable products and services on top of the world's data, powering everything from web to mobile to agentic experiences.

We're looking for a GTM Enablement Manager who enjoys translating technical concepts into language the field can use with confidence — someone who's as comfortable in a room with engineers as they are building the materials an AE needs to navigate a tricky customer conversation. This is a builder role — you'll own the strategy, content, and delivery that get our field (AEs, SEs, and CSMs) equipped to sell and support Apollo's current customers and future customers.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, you'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, and Field leadership — so the work you do shows up directly in how fast the team ramps and how well we retain customers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and own our enablement strategy end-to-end, building role-based learning paths for AEs, SEs, and CSMs across self-directed learning, just-in-time delivery, micro-learning, and major learning events.

 - Partner with RevOps to define field productivity baselines and the leading indicators — ramp time, certification engagement, time-to-first-value — that connect enablement work to business outcomes, and track whether training is actually landing over time.

 - Build a new-hire onboarding program from scratch, focused on minimizing ramp time and time-to-productivity for new field ICs.

 - Lead go-to-market readiness for major product releases, working closely with Product Marketing to take their messaging and turn it into use-case narratives, competitive intelligence, and customer-facing materials the field can actually use — then own getting it into their hands and taught.

 - Act as the connective tissue between engineering and the field, translating what's shipping and why it matters into language non-technical AEs and CSMs can use with confidence in front of customers.

 - Deliver training that actually lands — not just build the content, but leading the sessions, measuring impact and effectiveness, and adjusting as needed.

 - Bring AI into how the field works, using it to speed up content creation, mine tools like Gong for field insights, and track how reps are positioning Apollo with customers — while coaching AEs and CSMs on how to use AI in their own workflows.

 - Drive alignment across teams that don't report to you, pulling input and buy-in from Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Field leadership to get assets built and adopted.

WHO YOU ARE

You sit comfortably at the intersection of technical credibility and commercial fluency — equally at home talking API architecture with an engineer and coaching an AE on how to position it to a VP of Engineering. You think of enablement as part of the go-to-market engine, not a support function on the side of it. Your goal isn't to run a training calendar — it's to make the field measurably better at their jobs.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience operating in a fast-moving, high-growth environment, where you're helping shape the playbook rather than following one.

 - Hands-on experience building and delivering enablement programs — not just managing or orchestrating other people's content.

 - Real technical fluency: you understand the API layer and can converse credibly with engineers, with familiarity with GraphQL a plus (though not required at expert level).

 - Commercial acumen: you understand how enterprise buyers (VPs of Engineering, platform leaders, CTOs/CIOs) evaluate and buy infrastructure and developer tooling, and can convert technical capability into business value language a non-technical field IC can use with confidence. Familiarity with sales methodologies like MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and the ability to reinforce them through enablement content.

 - A proven track record of live delivery — not just content creation. You can teach a technical concept to a non-technical audience, read whether it's landing in real time, and adjust.

 - Demonstrated ownership in ambiguous environments: you've built something from scratch before, set your own priorities, and been accountable for the result.

 - Strong cross-functional influence skills: you've driven alignment and gotten things built by pulling in people who don't report to you.

 - Practical, hands-on AI fluency, not just familiarity — you've used AI as a force multiplier to get more out of your own work, and you can teach non-technical teammates to do the same.

ABOUT APOLLO

Apollo helps teams build, operate, and scale the graphs that power modern applications. If you've streamed a show, booked a trip, or read the news online, there's a good chance Apollo was working quietly behind the scenes. We support some of the largest and most sophisticated GraphQL platforms in the world.

But we're not here just to maintain the status quo. Apollo is redefining how software teams build and ship — bringing clarity, speed, and leverage to increasingly complex systems. Our platform gives teams a single, coherent way to connect clients, services, and now AI-powered experiences, without drowning in endpoints or bespoke integrations.

Just as importantly, we're building a company where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers. That means meaningful ownership, smart teammates, and tackling hard problems that actually matter. If you like moving fast, thinking deeply, and helping shape what comes next, you'll feel right at home here.

Location: This is a remote position that can be done from anywhere in the Eastern time zone in the US

Equal Opportunity: Apollo is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a talented and diverse workforce.

Privacy: California residents applying for positions at Apollo can see our privacy policy here https://www.apollographql.com/CCPA-Privacy-Notice-for-Employees.pdf.

E-Verify: Apollo is an E-Verify employer and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. For more information please visit E-Verify. https://www.e-verify.gov/

jobs.excerpt:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. 
 At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. Overview The GTM Compensation Leader owns the end-to-end strategy, design, and operations of sales compensation across the GTM organization. This role is the connective layer between RevOps, Finance, and Field leadership — translating business strategy into comp plans that drive the right behaviors, scale with the business, and hold up to audit and compliance scrutiny. You will lead a comp team, own the ICM/SPM platform, and be the primary voice on plan design, exception handling, and comp operations. 
 Core Responsibilities 
 Comp Plan Design & Strategy   
 
 Own the design of sales compensation plans across segments (Sales, CS/RA, SDR, Partnership, Solution Engineers and otherwhere applicable) — quota, accelerators, SPIFFs, and plan mechanics. 
 Translate GTM strategy (new logo, expansion, retention, Healthy ARR) into comp incentives that drive the intended rep behavior. 
 Partner with RevOps, GTM Leadership, and Finance to align comp design to business priorities each planning cycle. 
 
 Comp Operations & Exception Handling 
 
 Own end-to-end comp operations: crediting, calculations, payout accuracy, and dispute resolution. 
 Build scalable exception-handling logic and governance so one-off requests don't erode plan integrity. 
 Ensure timely, accurate payout cycles with clear audit trails. 
 
 ICM / SPM Platform Ownership :  
 
 Serve as the business owner for the ICM/SPM tool (e.g., Varicent, Everstage) — configuration, roadmap, and vendor relationship. 
 Lead or oversee implementation, migration, or optimization of the platform as the comp motion scales. 
 Ensure the platform reflects current plan logic with minimal manual workaround. 
 
 Compliance & Finance Partnership 
 
 Partner with Finance/Accounting to ensure comp expense recognition is compliant with ASC 606. 
 Own documentation and controls needed to support audit, SOX, and quarter/year-end close. 
 Ensure comp plan changes are properly evaluated for accounting and compliance impact before rollout. 
 
 Team Leadership 
 
 Lead and develop a sales compensation team; build a scalable operating model as headcount and plan complexity grow. 
 Set the bar for accuracy, responsiveness, and trust between the comp function and the field. 
 
 Change Management & Communication 
 
 Own communication and rollout of plan changes — clear, simple, and well-timed to the field. 
 Build feedback loops with field leadership to catch design issues early. 
 
 Scalable Systems & Governance 
 
 Build governance models (approval flows, exception thresholds, plan documentation standards) that scale without adding headcount. 
 Maintain a single source of truth for plan documents, rates, and quotas. 
 
 Key Qualifications 
 
 Experience leading a sales compensation team within a SaaS/tech environment 
 Hands-on experience implementing and/or owning an ICM or SPM tool — CaptivateIQ, Varicent or Everstage strongly preferred 
 Proven ownership of, and partnership across, comp plan design and comp operations 
 ASC 606 experience (comp expense recognition, accounting partnership) 
 Comfortable operating between strategy (plan design, GTM alignment) and execution (calculations, exceptions, payout accuracy) 
 Strong communication and change management skills — able to explain comp mechanics simply to the field 
 Based in NYC or Salt Lake City 
 
 Perks and Benefits:  
 
 We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. 
 Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. 
 Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 
 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. 
 Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. 
 Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. 
 Paid parental leave to support you and your family. 
 Company-wide recharge days each quarter. 
 Work from home stipend to help you succeed in a remote environment. 
 
 The annual salary hiring range for this position is $138,000 - $210,000 USD.  
 Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets.  
 We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect. 
 We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored. 
 
 Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. 
 To review Gong's privacy policy, visit https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/ for more details.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Marketing Orchestration
jobs.excerpt:
About Hightouch 
 Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. 
 Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. 
 Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. 
 At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About the Product Team 
 You’ll join a lean, world-class Product Team. We’ve thought deeply about what winning product culture looks like in competitive markets being reshaped by AI. The team prizes founder-level commercial instinct, the bandwidth to cover broad areas, and extremely fast iteration aided by product-minded engineers and AI. We’re the team that invented Reverse ETL, pioneered the Composable architecture, landed AI Decisioning as a category, and most recently invented Agentic Marketing. 
 Why this role matters 
 This portfolio is the majority of Hightouch's revenue — and it deserves a single, dedicated owner. Audiences, traits, experiments, analytics, and orchestration are the surfaces our customers live in every day, but the unifying vision across them has so far been carried by founders and shared across the team. We're hiring this role to change that: one person accountable for the health, direction, and growth of our core. 
 What you’ll own 
 We're looking for a product leader for the core surface area of Hightouch: the interfaces marketers live in every day and the largest driver of our revenue. You'll own a broad portfolio spanning: 
 
 Audiences — the segmentation and targeting experience at the center of Hightouch 
 Charts & Dashboards — analytics surfaces for customers to uncover audience insights and monitor performance 
 Experiments — automation and measurement tools to run & monitor cross-channel experiments 
 Trait Building — no-code interfaces to build custom business logic and data attributes to power marketing campaigns 
 Orchestration — primitives for how campaigns and journeys are sequenced and coordinated globally across all of Hightouch 
 
 We need someone who can drive clarity, set prioritization, and bring a unifying vision across that entire portfolio. 
 What you’ll do 
 The role’s mandate spans multiple modes of product work: from 0-1 innovation to deepening established surfaces to scaling emerging areas. A significant part of the job will be deciding what to prioritize and what outcomes to achieve in which order to hit our company revenue goals. Some examples include: 
 
 Building 0→1 in global orchestration: defining the right audience, campaign and journey primitives for AI-native, Fortune 100-class marketing programs 
 Expanding audience targeting & syncing to better support advanced use cases like couponing and live auctions 
 Transforming our investment in charts, dashboards, and experimentation to better interface with Hightouch Agentic Marketing 
 
 This is a senior, hands-on role — think “product GM.” You'll be fully accountable for both product adoption and go-to-market success, leading across multiple Engineering and Design workstreams. You'll present frequently to customers, work directly with executives, and shape company strategy. 
 About You 
 
 Customer Obsession: You are a relentless customer champion. Your superpower is the ability to forge deep connections, intuitively anticipating needs before customers can even articulate them. 
 Technical Aptitude: More than just understanding technical concepts, you're a translator who turns complex engineering challenges into elegant, accessible solutions. You speak both engineer and business fluently. 
 Strong Communicator: You can drive clarity and distill complex ideas into compelling narratives that inspire teams and resonate with users, turning insights into action. 
 Hunger and Speed: Speed isn't just a preference for you—it's a way of life. You thrive in a high-energy environment where rapid iteration and bold moves are the default, not the exception. 
 Outcome Mindset: You're not a feature factory—you're a strategic mastermind who reverse-engineers success. Every decision you make is laser-focused on driving measurable business impact, turning product vision into tangible results. 
 
 Interview Process 
 
 Hiring Manager Interview [30m]: Chat with Hiring Manager about past experiences and interests to assess role and company fit. 
 Technical & UX Interview [90m]: Live conversation with a Product Manager covering the technical architecture and user experience of a potential feature inside Hightouch. 
 Case Study Interview: Part 1 [45m]: Presentation of the take-home case study (1st part), focusing on problem space discovery and GTM validation. 
 Case Study Interview: Part 2 [45m]: Presentation of the take-home case study (2nd part), focusing on solution mapping and MVP scope. 
 
 We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals who are interested in tackling the problems above. This is a senior role, but we focus on impact and potential for growth more than years of experience. The salary range for this position is $240,000 - $320,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation in the form of ISO options, and offer early exercise and a 10 year post-termination exercise window. E-Verify Statement 
 Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 Anthropic is seeking an experienced Customer Programs Manager to build the operational foundation that allows our customer marketing engine to scale. As our advocacy and co-marketing programs grow across startups, digital-native businesses, and enterprise accounts, we need someone who can turn our scaled co-marketing program into a well-instrumented, repeatable and measurable system. You'll deploy resources and capital to create compelling customer stories across formats, and amplify them across both bespoke partnerships and agency-run campaigns. You’ll also own the broader customer marketing intake process and its tooling, and the system of record for how customers participate across advocacy and co-marketing. 
 You'll work closely with Sales, Partnerships, Marketing, Finance, and Brand, reconciling co-marketing spend each quarter, briefing agencies on which stories we want to tell, and partnering with Marketing Ops and Data Science to build the measurement framework we use to report back to leadership on impact. You'll help shape how a rapidly growing function operates, at a moment when customer proof is one of the most powerful levers we have for building trust in beneficial AI. 
 Key responsibilities: 

 Own the investment behind our customer co-marketing programs, covering allocation tracking, spend pacing, agency coordination, and quarterly budget reconciliation across a rotating cohort of customer accounts 

 Develop and execute co-marketing plans with participating customers that grow Claude adoption and the customer's own reach, coordinating with Growth Marketing on campaign strategy. 

 Run the always-on scaled co-marketing motion, co-producing high-quality creative assets with a rotating cohort of customers and deploying agency partners to amplify them as paid campaigns on the customer's own channels 

 Partner with Customer Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships to decide which customers we work with and build the criteria that keep those decisions consistent 

 Own the customer marketing intake process and its tooling, keeping it the system of record and building the playbooks that keep it consistent as we scale, partnering with Customer Marketing segment leads who own triage and prioritization for their segments 

 Define how we measure the impact of our customer marketing investments, working with Marketing Ops and Data Science, and use that measurement to shape investment decisions with leadership 

 Report back to participating customers on what their participation returned, measured on the outcomes they care about, like reach, engagement, and new customer acquisition 

 Use Claude as a core part of your operational toolkit — building skills, automating intake and triage, and finding leverage wherever a process can be made faster or smarter for the Customer Marketing team 

 Minimum qualifications 

 Managed co-marketing growth or partner investment programs and are comfortable with the reconciliation, forecasting, agency coordination, and stakeholder reporting that comes with it 

 Managed agencies as a working partner, developing the brief, directing the work, and holding the quality bar on co-branded creative

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole.  This is a builder role. Field Marketing at Anthropic is a small, scrappy team and the Public Sector is an area of growth for the business — there is no existing playbook for you to inherit. jobs.excerpt:
About Checkr Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic. We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company . As an Enterprise Business Development Representative , your job is to generate sales pipeline, or start the sales process - in other words, build the foundation of our sales team. As an Enterprise BDR, you’ll support the Checkr Enterprise sales team through thoughtful prospecting efforts and account research, focusing on generating outbound business pipeline with the ultimate goal of closed won business. BDRs make a major contribution to the Sales Organization by generating millions of dollars of new business pipeline each year. 
 Day to Day 
 
 Generate new business pipeline primarily through thoughtful, strategic outbound prospecting efforts 
 Create interest through multi-channel, personalized outbound outreach, including cold calling, LinkedIn and email across net new logos in assigned territory 
 Partner closely with Account Executives to identify and source net new pipeline, using multithreaded approach 
 Conduct thorough research to create the most effective outreach strategies with each account, ensuring you’re contacting the right people, at the right time, for the right reason  
 
 Responsibilities : 
 
 Generate qualified opportunities through outbound prospecting, calling and emailing  
 Work with your manager and account executives to create an account penetration plan for your book of business 
 Consistently work your book of business, while balancing any inbound engagements or marketing generated leads via effective time management 
 Demonstrate knowledge of Checkr solutions and value propositions clearly and concisely 
 Demonstrate knowledge of the prospects’ and curiosity where you may have gaps 
 Maintain and improve CRM data quality as it relates to your book of business. 
 Partner with two to three Account Executives to build a pipeline of new business opportunities 
 Ability to multitask and prioritize a large list of accounts  
 Perform market research to gather information about prospects, and add prospects to CRM  
 
 Basic Qualifications: 
 
 You have experience in a world-class outbound sales development role, in the ENT space is a plus (6 - 9 months minimum preferred) 
 Experience with Salesforce 
 You’re a quick learner that is excited to take on challenging projects 
 You bring a collaborative team mentality to the table 
 You have the ability to self-motivate, prioritize and manage unstructured time 
 You’re personable, a clear and direct communicator, and can make connections with both prospects and internal teams at Checkr 
 You have the ability to excel in a fast-paced environment and are comfortable with change. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 
 You have a track record of success in effectively developing and managing outbound pipeline at a SaaS (Software as a Service) company, selling into Enterprise businesses (for clarity, this is a business with >15k employees) 
 You have experience using sales tools such as Outreach, Sales Navigator or equivalent sales tech stack  
 You have created successful outbound email messaging to source your own meetings with prospects 
 You consistently met or exceeded your quota in an outbound sales development role 
 An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes 
 
   Pay Transparency Disclosure 
 We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website. Hourly On-target Earnings (Denver, CO) $82,000 — $97,000 USD What We Offer 
 
 A fast-paced and collaborative environment 
 Learning and development allowance 
 Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement 
 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage 
 Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services 
 Flexible PTO policy 
 Monthly wellness stipend 

 At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location. 
 Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com . 
 As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do. 
 Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI): Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive. About the Role & Team 
 The U.S. Sales Development team at Amplitude is looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our dynamic New York office. 
 SDRs at Amplitude are pipeline in two ways. You generate opportunities that fuel the business, and you develop into the next generation of Amplitude talent. We invest in this role intentionally: through structured training, close collaboration with senior sellers, and a clear path to growth into roles across the organization. Promotion from within is something we take seriously, not just something we say. 
 As the first point of contact for potential customers, the SDR team plays a critical role in driving pipeline generation and revenue growth. We run a true all-bound motion: you own outbound prospecting, follow up on inbound leads and MQLs, and activate opportunities through field events and executive experiences. By pairing strategic research with creative outreach and in-person relationship building, SDRs lay the foundation for Amplitude's expansion into new and existing accounts. 
 This role provides a unique opportunity to build expertise across sales, marketing, and account management at one of the most respected analytics platforms in the world. 
 What You’ll Do 
 
 Run a full all-bound motion: drive outbound prospecting, follow up on inbound MQLs, and convert field event registrants and attendees into pipeline. 
 Target and convert key accounts using personalized campaigns, strategic research, and account-level signal analysis. 
 Develop a strong understanding of Amplitude's product offerings to support discovery calls and evaluation cycles with potential customers. 
 Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, personalize outreach at scale, and surface the right accounts and contacts at the right time. 
 Collaborate with Account Executives, SDR Leadership, and Enablement teams to identify best practices and share learnings. 
 Consistently exceed quarterly and annual targets while maintaining a high standard of excellence. 
 Must be available to work from the New York office every Tuesday through Thursday. 
 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 Strong track record of consistent success across academics, athletics, work, or internships. 
 Demonstrated ability to work effectively in collaborative, team-oriented settings. 
 High level of curiosity, empathy, and a genuine drive to keep learning. 
 Proven ability to take initiative, solve problems proactively, and drive measurable results. 
 Openness to feedback and a commitment to continuous professional development. 
 Ability to perform in fast-paced, high-accountability environments. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Experience building and managing pipeline in a high-growth environment. 
 Comfort experimenting with and improving sales processes using data and analytics. 
 Familiarity with SaaS sales tools, systems, and processes, including AI-powered prospecting and productivity tools. 
 
 Our values: 
 At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers: 
 
 Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view. 
 Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success. 
 Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others. 
 Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success. 
 
 We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers. 
 Some of our benefit programs include: 
 
 Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans 
 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually 
 Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more 
 Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more 
 Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support 
 Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions 
 Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP) 
 
 Other fun facts about Amplitude:  
 
 Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2. 
 We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.  
 We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.  
 We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.  
 We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.  
 We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo. 
 Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom. 
 
 Amplitude provides equal employment opportunities (EEO). All applicants are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation. 
 Based on legislation in New York City, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in New York City. Salary range: $74,000 - $112,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission) By applying for this job, you acknowledge that Amplitude processes your personal data in accordance with the Amplitude Applicant Privacy Notice . 
 Staying Safe - Protect Yourself From Recruitment Fraud We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Amplitude recruiters and/or hiring managers. Amplitude will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Amplitude recruiting team will come from an @ amplitude.com  email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to  this article . Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Shape the future of E-commerce by transforming supplier partnerships into strategic advantages for Amazon's Consumables Private Brands business. As a Customer Success Manager, you'll directly influence the success of Amazon's own private brand portfolio — a global range of consumables products built to meet customers' daily needs — and play a crucial role in scaling these brands on the world's largest e-commerce platform. Join our dynamic team as a Customer Success Manager supporting strategic supplier partnerships within the Consumables Private Brands organization. In this role, you'll drive business growth, enhance supplier satisfaction, and improve customer experience through data-driven insights and collaborative relationship building. You'll work closely with Private Brand stakeholders across WW Consumables, implementing tactical plans, providing strategic guidance, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that create measurable impact for both vendors and customers. You have strong financial acumen, a high attention to detail, and a healthy obsession for the rapidly evolving world of consumer packaged goods and product innovation. Key job responsibilities Partner with private brand suppliers to develop and execute strategic business plans across marketing, merchandising, and supply chain management, with a focus on scaling selection on .com based on market trends and customer needs. Analyze category P&L performance on a weekly and monthly basis, monitoring profitability goals and diving deep where needed to drive continuous improvement. Build and maintain collaborative relationships while serving as the primary point of contact for private brand supplier needs, influencing stakeholders and helping them understand brand positioning, key points of difference, and target customer. Guide suppliers through Amazon's tools, policies, and growth opportunities while partnering closely with supply chain to support operational planning, forecasting, and inventory investments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Commercialization, Pricing, Instock Management, marketing, product development, finance, and transportation to deliver on net revenue and customer satisfaction goals. Develop a thorough understanding of the Consumables market, seasonality, and global trends, continuously monitoring competitor efforts and identifying new private brand selection opportunities. Contribute to process improvements and innovation initiatives that benefit the broader Consumables Private Brands organization A day in the life As a Customer Success Mgr, a typical day might include: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve supplier inquiries and implement solutions across the private brand portfolio Review and analyze category performance data to identify growth and profitability opportunities Develop and present strategic recommendations to suppliers and internal stakeholders Participate in team meetings and knowledge-sharing sessions focused on private brand strategy and innovation Manage multiple projects while maintaining high service standards across the vendor base

jobs.excerpt:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew. 
 We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization. 
 To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success. 
 Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture. 
 If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you. WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 The Enterprise BDR on the General Business team is the engine behind Braze's large company growth. You'll partner with Account Executives to identify, engage, and qualify prospects at companies with 5000 employees+, helping B2C brands discover how Braze can transform their customer engagement. 
 This is a high-impact role where you'll blend volume-driven outreach with personalized, consultative prospecting. You'll research accounts, craft relevant messaging, and create opportunities that directly fuel Braze's pipeline. 
 Every individual has a personal quota, and shares a team goal. The team is collaborative, communicative and we are always the first to take action. There's a lot of support and camaraderie with plenty of room to be proactive and take control of your own sales success.  
 BDRs gain huge value from working together at our offices. BDRs at Braze have a hybrid schedule, which means they will be in office a minimum of 3 days a week at our Austin location. This allows our team to thrive in a learning environment together. 
 Responsibilities: 
 
 Prospect into Enterprise (5000 + employees) accounts across industries like retail, media, fintech, and travel 
 Generate qualified meetings for the Enterprise AE team through outbound outreach (email, phone, LinkedIn) 
 Research accounts to identify pain points around customer engagement, cross-channel messaging, and data activation 
 Collaborate with AEs to develop territory strategies and prioritize high-potential accounts 
 Maintain accurate activity and pipeline data in Salesforce 
 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 
 
 Consistently hitting or exceeding monthly meeting and pipeline targets 
 Building a repeatable outreach motion that balances efficiency with personalization 
 Developing strong product knowledge to speak credibly about Braze's value to prospects 
 
 WHO YOU ARE 
 
 Experience: 8+ months in outbound prospecting in sales, customer-facing, or high-activity roles 
 Prior experience in enterprise or complex sales environments is a plus, but not required if you've shown strong ramp in a similar role. 
 Communication:Strong written and verbal skills; ability to craft compelling, concise outreach and explain your reasoning, not just your results 
 Coachability: Eager to learn, take feedback, and iterate quickly 
 Resilience: Comfortable with rejection; motivated by targets and competition, not discouraged by "no" 
 Curiosity:Genuine interest in martech, SaaS, and how brands connect with customers

jobs.excerpt:
Airtable is the no-code app platform that empowers people closest to the work to accelerate their most critical business processes. More than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, rely on Airtable to transform how work gets done. At Airtable, we are passionate about how our product democratizes software creation and empowers anyone to “create anything.” As the Business Development Manager, you will manage the hiring, training, strategy, and design of a newly built out BDR team. This includes helping build the right outbound messaging, refining our qualification criteria, and developing the next generation of Airtable sellers.  
 Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. This opens up all sorts of exciting possibilities for our Sales team in terms of who our potential customer is. As a result, the demand for our product has outpaced the capacity of our sales team. 
 Are you looking for some truly fascinating work, where you'll work alongside a best in class team, harnessing the power of an extraordinary product, for a company with unlimited growth potential?  
 What you'll do 
 
 Hire, train and manage a team of Business Development Representatives. 
 Develop and validate new strategies for prospecting and outbound efforts that can be scaled across the Sales team. 
 Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Data Science, Growth and Ops teams to develop thoughtful and innovative approaches to prospecting. 
 Operate a highly agile and experimental team that can quickly formulate, test and validate new Sales growth tactics.  
 Implement, improve and standardize key sales processes in service of driving consistent and repeatable motions that predictably drive revenue growth. 
 Actively use Salesforce to manage BDR sales processes and set standards for performance metrics.  
 
 Who you are 
 
 You have 5+ years of SaaS experience working within revenue focused teams responsible for selling software solutions into multiple industries.  
 You have 1+ years of experience leading a business development team.  
 You have a deep understanding of outbound selling and prospecting.  
 You have strong analytical skills.  
 Experience building and leading experimental teams.  
 You thrive partnering with different cross functional teams to design and execute effective ways to get customers on the phone.  
 You are a strong written and verbal communicator.  
 You are passionate about our overall mission and how customers can use Airtable.  
 You are scrappy, resourceful and a creative problem solver when discovering the business needs of your customer and understanding how Airtable plugs into the bigger picture.  
 
 Airtable is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any characteristic protected by applicable federal and state laws, regulations and ordinances. Airtable is committed to participating in the interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants. 
 Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills, and experience. 
 Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits, restricted stock units, and may include incentive compensation.   To learn more about our comprehensive benefit offerings, please check out   Life at Airtable .
